We have been tenants of Campus Property Management for 13 years and climbing, we have seen a lot of Managers come and go, before we could get any improvements done to our unit, but in the past couple of years, the Manager we have now has been really working hard to get and keep our unit in tip top shape, we would also like to thank Ben and Bill for their friendly and quick response to our refrigerator issue yesterday, they were very helpful as my husband wasn’t available to assist me.

Thank you all for everything you do. 👍🏼😀

Dustin Scaff was very professional and did great work. He finished his assignment in a timely manner and corrected the problem. I’d refer him over and over again!!! Also very polite. …. 408 Kenwood rd. Champaign,IL 61821 (site)

The apartment our boys moved into had some pretty serious electrical issues but Doug was sent out and he worked tirelessly at getting everything fixed. He was very polite and respectful. He was great to the boys as well. He's a keeper for sure!! Great guy!
Lots of reviews left on here that are in my opinion are petty reviews. So I'm here giving 5 stars because I believe community property management is honestly always doing their best.

I am very satisfy with the service I received from Bill Mannin. My Dryer had a loud noise while drying and he came to look at it.  He was very considerate and fixed the dryer outside our apartment to avoid making a mess inside the apartment. He was very nice and fixed the problem right away. I usually read reviews on how CPM has poor service but from my experience, it is very excellent especially what Bill Mannin did it. Thanks to Bill Mannin and CPM for their wonderful service and living with CPM for 2 years was a wonderful experience.

I called the office Monday evening right before they closed (sorry) and put in a maintenance request. Wednesday morning I woke up to Ben fixing my tub that was clogged with hair. Ben was very helpful and even offered a few diy lessons for my tub and closet door that was off the hinges. The leasing office might suck but the maintenance men have always done a great job!

*avoid at all cost* The entire apartment was filthy upon arrival. Not only were there layers of stainage and dirt on everything, but the carpet had not been touched whatsoever. If they are charging people to clean it, it should be done before the next lessees move in. We also had broken light fixtures in 2 of the rooms, broken windows which are yet to be repaired within the 3 months we have been here which i'm sure is a safety violation. Maintenance comes and goes without actually doing anything, always saying that they will come back later and don't. We also were over charged for utilities when no one was in the apartment to possibly go over! Also, to top it off the elevator stops working constantly and the certification is expired from the city!
owner_response_text: Hello Amy,  apartment cleaning is done by outside companies who always leave their contact information in the apartment to come back at each tenants request. We take maintenance requests such as broken windows seriously and would never leave an issue like that unresolved! Please contact your property manager or leasing@cpm-apts.com to submit a maintenance request or ask us any questions you may have, we're more than happy to help

review_text: Mr. Travist did an excellent job fixing our water heater machine. He came by the same day as I called CPM to stop the water leakage. He came in right next morning to enhance the functionality of our heater so that we can have warm shower! It was a pleasure to meet him and thank him so much.

The emergency maintenance service is good. When I called the hotline and told them that my A/C needed to be repaired. Stephen Mills arrived at my apartment in a short time. He went up and down the roof several times and got the A/C worked.

I called a request to have a shelf in my closet fixed and Jay came the very next day in the morning. He was very efficient and polite! Most maintenance staff don’t take their shoes off in the apartment but Jay noticed and did (haha).  He’s also a friendly, pleasant guy. Thanks for fixing my closet and helping keep my place clean, Jay!!!

After waiting nearly a month for supposed "turn over", we paid for broken knobs, a jammed mailbox, exposed wiring, a horrible paint job, etc., etc. at Woodcrest Apartments. We still have pics and videos from September and October to prove it. Most of it was covered up pretty good during the initial tour. No one stayed one night in this aapartment. It was supposed to be ready before the school year started. My boyfriend and his son had to move in with me during the school year and have lived at MY HOUSE for the last 6 months, because it was still not up to par and yet they've claimed somehow we owe them $763.50??? They owe us our money back and peace of mind. SMH.

Great and quick service. Jeremy Klein was very helpful in helping finding the best fit apartment for me and my friend. He responded very quickly and was able to schedule visits the same day. Apartments are large and at great locations as well. Great price for the value.

I've been living in one of this company's apartment for over a year. Their services are good, the rent is cheap and the apartment's quality is good enough for the price. I think the customer service is remarkable. For example Jeremy Klein, who has showed me other apartments, was friendly, on time, and patient with all my questions.

Jay came and repaired the two holes in my ceiling after the sprinkler system recall.  I have lived in the same apartment for eighteen years and he was very careful and courteous.   Katie has been very helpful and understanding in helping with various things I needed done as well.  Thanks so much!

I haven’t started living here but Jeremy Klein showed the apartment we ended up signing for. He was very sweet and actually lives in a CPM so he could give us an idea of how much the limits are etc. Felt very safe with him-good guy.

The guy we signed with (Ed?) was kinda cold and unfriendly tho

I would give CPM 0 stars. I decided to live at one of their apartments because the person who showed me my apartment was very friendly but I didn't know much about their deficient maintenance and poor professionalism. Our elevator has been problematic several times in the past year and now it is completely down. It hasn't been working properly for months and now it has been completely down for over two weeks. I am paying $800 per month and I think it is unfair that everyone who lives in the apartment is paying for something that doesn't even work. Furthermore, I received messages about my apartment being shown to people multiple times but sometimes I felt that it was a little last minute to notify me as they would message me only 2-3 hours before. I was infuriated when they notified me about a potential tour only a few minutes before. I called the office about this and they said, "it is stated in my lease." I am aware of this but I believe that it is beyond unprofessional to deliver a message like this. After arguing and asking to simply consider my perspective, they told me that they are not going to show the apartment on that day, but they did so in a rude tone of voice. As I read reviews from other people who had bad experiences with CPM, I am more concerned continuing to pay for poor service, amenities, and being ripped off of security deposit money.
-------------------------------------------------------------------
Few days after the above situation, someone from CPM contacted me. They asked for a meeting for them to explain the situation with our elevator. I asked for the explanation through email. In the email, they said that they signed a contract with an elevator repair company "LAST WEEK." I feel that this stressful experience could have been easily prevented if they put a notice on the elevator about the situation and didn't rudely speak to me on the phone about another issue. They completely ignored the part about their staff speaking in an unkindly manner and gave no apology to both situations. After they "explained their position," they asked me about "modifying" my review about them. There was no apology whatsoever.
owner_response_text: We are sorry to hear you are unhappy with our services. We would love to speak to you about these issues. Feel free to give us a call anytime or email us at info@cpm-apts.com

review_text: Jay came over today to fix my window because air was coming in. He was very nice and made sure he did everything to my liking. He also fixed my door as well because I was having a problem with it. Never have I had someone come do work and did more than was asked of him in the request. Thanks so much Jay‼️

My wife and I have lived here for nearly one year now, and we're going to live for another year. I absolutely love this place and the friendliest neighbors. I want to especially thank Jonathan R for his help.He is attentive to issues. He quickly responds to any questions, requests, or concerns that we may have. He is also very personable and always makes sure you are happy. I would highly recommend living here!

Jeremy Klein showed my roommates and me numerous apartments. He was very professional and could answer all the questions we had. He showed us one apartment we were interested in more than four times by our request before we committing. He was also able to get us a really good deal for the apartment!

Had a personal experience with a roommate and this company was able to find me a new place within the hour. Great at acknowledging a bad situation and prioritizing a students safety. Special thanks to Lisa Shoemaker & Michael Reinhart especially during covid 19 by Negotiating a new contract with me and allowing to feel safe and secured.
owner_response_text: Thanks, we're happy to hear this Tayler!

review_text:
Maintenance people never wear a mask during the pandemic and they always break in without any prior notice. They just knock on the door and enter my room if I don’t response immediately even if I’m sleeping. Last time the staff broke in saying he need to go to the roof and just passed my room several times. He came in the morning then I notified the office immediately. Staff in the office told me it was a mistake and promise to notify me next time before they come, but the maintenance people broke in again later. I asked again if they can email me before people enter in, then the office staff said they only knock and enter.
DO NOT live here if you wanna stay safe during this pandemic. I rented the whole unit alone to keep social distance, and I didn’t know people will regularly come in without masks.
Also, be aware when signing the lease, that they charge you $120 cleaning fee if you don’t give them a receipt to proof you have professionals done it.
owner_response_text: Hi Rachelle! We're so sorry that this has been your experience. We take our tenants safety and health seriously and will make sure that this is addressed. Please feel free to give us a call or email us at info@cpm-apts.com if you have any further questions or concerns for us.

review_text: We had a good experience with CPM. The guy who gave us a tour of apartments, Jeremy, was really helpful and informative and we ended up signing a lease. The apartments we saw were well maintained and value for money. Will recommend.

I have lived in a CPM rental apartment for over 7 years. I have never changed landlords. CPM has good service and is able to deal with maintenance problems quickly. There is a person that I know his name is Johnathan . He is a very kind manager, nice and helpful! and glad that he leads the team to continue to provide me with high-quality services。

Had our bathroom floor replaced today, Jay and the rest of the maintenance staff that we had were nice, respectful, diligent, and as quiet as the job could allow. The floor looks great and it only took a few hours to complete a job that would have taken many experienced carpenters much longer.

I live in the building attached to their management office. They are incredibly disorganized. We overpaid them 1500 some time ago. Despite repeated attempts to get it back, a month long 'glitch' in the portal made it look like we were behind on rent. When I went to clear things up with them, I was told not to worry. But the following day the internet was shut off. On a holiday weekend. When most of campus was closed. And obviously their office was closed for the next 3 days. Some of the managers are trying their best but can't do much with the sheer lack of communication in the office.
owner_response_text: Hi Aasiya! We are sorry to hear that you are not happy with us, your property manager was under the impression that this issue had been resolved last week but would be happy to sit down with you guys again to address this misunderstanding and anything we can do to improve your experience! Please contact us with any issues you have with the building and we will take care of them for you, thank you!

review_text: So far so good! Bill Mannin (one of the maintenance men) just fixed my dishwasher, and he was so nice! I appreciate that he took the initiative to fix something that he noticed was leaking on a previous visit that I hadn’t even noticed yet! Thanks CPM! Here’s hoping you guys come by to fix my bowing cabinets soon!

I am a current occupant of the Refinery and I am happy with the service till date. Katie is a really nice woman. She truly cares about what you need, and goes above and beyond to get things fixed. I highly recommend her.
owner_response_text: We're happy to hear this, thank you for your feedback!

review_text: Jeremy Klein was extremely helpful in helping us choose a property. He’s always so friendly and responsive! He managed to show us properties the same day that we requested to see them, sometimes on very short notice, and is always thorough when he explains what features a property has, what’s included in our rent, and in general, how CPM manages its properties, and never assumes that we already just know the information. I would highly reccommend him!

I had a great experience with CPM. Really understanding (late one time on rent and they waived it since we were confused) and cheap, any maintenance issues were handled within 48 hours, the place was adequately clean when we arrive but I like to clean so I gave it another wipe down which didn't take long (since it was already clean). The staff is kind and patient, and it's great! Would rent again!

I have stayed in victoria point apt by CPM for over 4 years.
I must stay ,the leasing office staff is very friendly, professional and  helpful
They took care of the all the complains on time.
not only that , but since I stayed for long time in same appartment.
I had requested them to replace the vinyl in my kitchen at their cost ,since I lived here for longer time .
The staff really turned out to be helpful and specially, CPM then Manager Jonathan Rojano was very cordial and ready to help us and all of the concerns were taken care of .
He personally visited the apartment and made sure it is being taken care of.

Someone tried to break into our apartment and broke the door while we were out. We called CPMs emergency number and they sent Bill Mannin, a maintenance worker, who arrived 25 minutes after our initial call which late at night. He provided excellent and speedy service. If someone breaks in the future I'd definitely want Bill to come fix it.

Thank you Mr. Stephen Mills for fixing our A/C quickly and efficiently! He described the problem in simple terms so that anyone could understand. Our apartment was too hot because both coils were dirty, causing them to freeze over. He cleaned it up and now the A/C is functioning better than before!

Jeremy Klein is very informative and answered all my questions in a professional and sincere manner. He has done above and beyond my own expectations and I cannot thank him enough. He has been my go to guy for apartments at CPM for the past 2 years and I highly recommend him.

We looked at several apartments earlier in the school year, and CPM was the most helpful and informative. Jeremy was our agent and he was super helpful in showing us multiple apartments, and we ended up signing a lease for the one he first showed. Though we lost the apartment signing for the unit we really, really wanted due to a system error and miscommunication, CPM was great at helping us find another apartment. All our questions were answered quickly and with a lot of helpful tips.

I was given a couple of tours by Jeremy Klein and I can say I always had a positive experience. He was honest about the apartments and generally kind. If I ever had any question, it was easy to reach out to him and it made the whole leasing process easier.

The fact that managers know a winter storm is coming and knows the severity of the effects it can have on the apartments (Daniel Towers) just highlights how much consideration they have for students that live there and their schedules. Definitely wouldn’t recommend living here unless you want managers that don’t care about your daily life during a stressful semester in the midst of a pandemic. Also, my apartment is flooded because the heat doesn’t work due to pipes that are frozen. Pipes that could’ve been taken care of before a strong winter hits.
owner_response_text: Hi Jeanette, we have 24/7 emergency maintenance staff ready to assist rain or shine, please call in if you have not already so we can get someone to take care of you right away. We also have customer service available by phone or livechat at all times during our business hours and we would love to hear about any specific issues you have faced regarding this storm and what we can do to help. Thank you!

review_text: We lived at 510 E Michigan for over 2yrs and the Property Manager Carol McDonald was wonderful!  We really appreciated her attentiveness and general positive nature.  She addressed every issue we had quickly and professionally.  She also did so many little things beyond her job description that made the stay personal.  We had to move on but have fond memories of our time in Urbana at CPM.

Jeremy Klein showed my friend and I a great place at 202 E Chalmers and we signed the following week. He was very helpful and full of information and helped us find a good apartment. Looking forward to working with CPM and Jeremy throughout next school year.

The property manager, Maria D. Meneses was exceptional! After signing a lease we found ourselves having to move out of the country, and she assisted in the process or re-renting our apartment and ensuring we weren't responsible for the lease any longer. She was very honest, prompt will all responses and always ensured that our concerns were met. She has created an awesome environment for this CPM community! Highly recommended!

Really unhappy with our current situation. They will come in without giving you any notice at all and leave ridiculous notes on your door if your apartment is dirty. One of the strangest rules on these notes is that everything needs to be put away in cabinets and nothing can be on your counter tops. I get that they don't want to show a cluttered apartment to potential tenants, but they will threaten to charge you for a professional cleaning service rather than give you notice that they're coming and give you a chance to clean the apartment yourself.

Apparently we asked them one too many times to please give us 24 hours notice before they come because now they are "suspicious" of us. As tenants we value our privacy, but CPM does not. Michael is our property manager and he seems more concerned with firing off hot-headed emails to us that are so incoherent you'd think he was typing drunk. Either way, they do a great job of being completely unprofessional.

My advice if you plan to rent with them is to not rent with them. But if you do sign with them, don't tell them you want notice when they just show up at your door because they will become "suspicious" and check your apartment even more frequently.

I have been a resident at Victoria Point with CPM since July 2017.  The manager here Katie Babb has been the best!  Residents are offered regular office hours or opportunities to make appointments to meet.  Katie has partnered with me to troubleshoot renter questions, such as how to make energy efficient decisions. Katie is quick to communicate to the Victoria Point community when maintenance and preventative care are occurring on the property.
I have requested maintenance work resolved efficiently and each visit is documented.
I also appreciate the manager Katie’s collaboration with the Victoria Point community. She listens to concerns and requests, and works to ensure a safe and pleasant place to live. I appreciate the care that is taken of the units and feel like a partner in having a great home here at Victoria Point. The common spaces are regularly cleaned.  Landscaping, lawn care, and snow removal from the parking lot is consistent.  One of my favorite things about this unit is all of the natural light I can enjoy. The opportunity to use the Refinery Gym as a benefit from residing here is another perk.  I have just renewed my lease and am happy to live at Victoria Point. @CPM_APTS

My roommates and I were struggling to find an apartment that everyone liked for a while. We made an appointment to view the apartments at 48 E John St and fell in love with the layout! Jeremy Klein showed us our options and was very kind and made the leasing process easy.

My roommates and I viewed 304 E. Daniel with one of the leasing agents Brendan. He was very helpful, personable, and knew a lot about the apartment layouts he showed us. He was able to answer all of our questions for us! We signed our lease and can't wait to live there!

I lived in CPM apartments for the three years that I lived off of campus and I thoroughly enjoyed my experience. CPM was always very responsive to issues that my roommate had with our apartment and accommodated us accordingly. Our leasing agent, Jeremy, was always so kind and helpful whenever we came in to speak with him.

**EDITED**

Original Review: First of all, it took us 10 MONTHS to get our AC and heat fixed. There is no way to contact maintenance directly, so my roommates and I had to leave over 20 maintenance requests and finally reach out to our property manager (Dakota Ruff) and threaten to withhold rent for it to finally get taken care of. Second, Dakota Ruff is a nice man, but screwed me and my roommates over by "being new". When we signed the lease for next year, he told us our rent would be cheaper than it actually is. Now none of us can afford to pay for rent and apparently there's "nothing he can do" because "his hands are tied", not even offering to help pay for his mistake. Do not sign with CPM.

Edited Review: After I left my review above, the staff of CPM called me and came to my door to correct the issue with rent, although I'm not exactly sure they would have had I not left the review above. They have a nice staff, though.
I should clarify that it took us 10 months to get our AC/heat fixed due to the maintenance staff not doing follow-ups (although asked repeatedly to do so) because they would leave and it would be working, but 20 minutes later it was broken again. It was no fault of CPM, but the maintenance (and how to contact them) needs improvement.

Ed Rice showed my friend and I three different apartment buildings and was very patient with us in choosing which one we liked best. He followed up with us every couple days to make sure all our questions were answered and updated us with the availability of each place before we decided. Looking forward to living with CPM next year!

I lived with CPM for a summer thanks to a sublease. The process to put my name on the lease was very easy and the security deposit reimbursement was also within the time frame they said it was gonna take. They also have now a chatting system service which is very useful when you are in class and cannot make a phone call. I have to say though that the new website is way to much user friendly than the crappy one they used to have before. I also like their newsletter a lot since I get to know first hand what are the events going on in the area. For the price and knowing what I exactly need as a college student I would stay again with them.

We are having a great experience with CPM so far. As an incoming international student, I was wary about many things but, CPM staff has always been very courteous & cooperative. Especially the maintenance requests always get solved within a day or two.  Special thanks to the leasing agent Will Whittier and property manager Mike Najjaro for always being very prompt and respectful in their responses.

Bill Mannin came to our rescue when our ceiling starting leaking due to an overflowwing toilet from the apartment above us. We called Emergency Maintenance because this happened on a weekend and Bill was at our apartment within 20 minutes. He came back later that evening as well and was such a friendly guy. He even hung our rugs out on the balcony to dry and appologized for the innconvience even though it was completely out of anyones control. Bill is the best!

Our apartment sprung a leak in the living room. When we thought there was no hope, the maintenance man Ben came to the rescue. He not only cleaned up the mess and fixed the leak, but he also warmed our hearts. He went above and beyond to make sure a leak will never spring up again. He even made sure that our apartment will not grow mold. He explained everything to us.
Ben is the man. When your apartment floods at 11 pm on a Tuesday, Ben is the man to call. Forever in our hearts, the ladies of apt 14.

My roommates and I viewed 304 East Daniel with one of your leasing agents Brendan. He was very helpful and knowledgeable about the building and showed us each layout of each apartment. We signed our lease and can't wait for next year!

So, our AC broke on Jun 9, and as of Jun 12, it's still not fixed. Originally this was a glowing review because that's how they pay their maintenance people, but right now I'm going to be real.

We've been living here for 3 years, so I have some experience.

CPM has good people in it. Carol, the property manager for Michigan East, is amazing. Ben, the maintenance guy that came out Jun 9 to loan us a portable AC (that makes one bedroom tolerable) was great as well.

But, CPM as an organization is fairly incompetent. Every single August, they completely forget how to do autopay, leading to week long fights with their Accounting department to figure out how to pay the rent. It should be easy, but it never is. Maintenance is very quick to bandage problems, but they take their time in actually fixing issues.

I still gave CPM a 4 star rating, because despite CPM's chronic understaffing, we still like the apartment. Usually things work, we love the location, and we have a great buffer in Carol.

Jay came to fix the toilet today. He arrived quickly and solved it with his proficiency , really a great job.
In addition, during the time visiting apartments, Edward Rice and Dakota Ruff were quite nice and answered questions patiently, eventually I decided to sign the lease for the next year.Thanks so much!

Excellent service and very polite staff. Thanks for Bill Mannin who coming to help us. He was very polite and bring our a new washing machine when the older one couldn't work well. He also offer clean up for the room to put washing machine. That's very kind of him.

I am a parent of 3 University of Illinois students. I felt that Campus Property Management was one of the most responsive management teams that I have dealt with in Champaign. They were always very professional, courteous and helpful (Amanda & Dakota were great!!) All of my questions and requests were addressed promptly and thoroughlly. In addition, they have an outstanding maintenance staff. Campus Property Management exceeded all of my expectations. Thanks for a great experience!

Cheap, friendly agent service. Brendan has regularly shown me apartments and houses over the last 2-3 years, and has always had answers to even more questions than I could think to ask.

CPM is typically pretty cheap, so it's also important to understand that you, as a tenant, will have to take a pretty engaged position whenever you have maintenance concerns or similar, but maintenance will get the work done as long as you keep communicating with CPM.

I just signed with CPM and it will be my first year living with them. Right off the bat, I had a good experience. Madison gave me tours and was extremely friendly when we met. During the tour, she was very informative and was super reliable after the tour as well.

Do not rent from Campus Property Management. The rent is very affordable but their customer service and maintenance are subpar. They take weeks to make repairs and you have to keep calling them. The property manager never knows when they are coming to make repairs or if the repairs were done and how. When they do make the repairs they make them as cheap and poorly done as possible. My bathtub began peeling when I moved in. Maintenance came in 3 times and just repainted over it which continued to peel. They finally fixed properly after almost 3 months. My bathroom had a mildew smell in it since move in. Water was leaking in the wall. That didn't get properly fixed until I called the city inspector on them. I had a gas leak in my furnace  after the utility company shut the gas off I called the after hours maintenace line. They came brought some space heaters because it was the weekend and told me that it would probably get fixed sometime in the next week because of the holiday. It only got fixed in a timely manner because the city inspector was coming to reassess the violations. No heat means he can condemn the property. I live in a duplex with a large shared parking lot and driveway for 4 units. CPM says that the tenants are responsible for snow removal for a shared lot. I guess we should flip and coin to see who should do it. They deactivate your tenant portal to make it more inconvenient for you to pay your rent. If you're looking for a affordable place to live go with CPM that's the only good thing about living here.

Jeremy showed me a number of apartments and even went above and beyond to show me other nearby apartments that we didn't initially plan to see but he thought I might like. He answered all my questions and made sure we covered everything I might like to know. Even after the showing, he was available to ask questions to. Ultimately, he helped me find a perfect place and get a lease in order for next year!

This was my first year living with CPM. I had a great experience. I signed the lease somewhat hesitantly after reading reviews, but CPM has definitely exceeded all of my expectations. When I had a maintenance issue, they made sure to have someone out to fix it right away. The front office staff was always very friendly and ready to help. I never had an issue with payments or billing. I have really enjoyed living with CPM and will continue to recommend the apartments to anyone looking for nice, affordable housing in Champaign-Urbana.

I lived with CPM for one year during my senior year of undergrad. I moved in with my roommates that had previously lived with CPM and had nothing but positive experiences with the management company.  Contrary to some negative reviews and rumors, we didn't encounter any problems living with CPM. Although we didn't have many problems that required maintenance, if we did need help with anything, they were always quick to fix the problem. Living with CPM offers many affordable options for undergraduate students looking to live in a safe location while also saving money. Specifically, I have had excellent experiences with the staff being friendly and helpful. Kirsten Jeffrey specifically was very professional and sets a high standard for customer service.

Where I'm living rn is a newly built apt so the interiors are nicely done. The rooms and kitchen are furnished well, too. The rent was quite cheap for a newly built, fancy apartment. You might experience moderate noise problems from upstairs on Friday nights but for me the problem was easily solved after l left a note for upstair neighbors. (Noting that every apt I've been in Champaign always had noise probs but CPM was the only place where I could find a solution.) I recently talked to CPM agent on phone and he was a kind person as well.
owner_response_text: Hello! We have not heard about this issue in our building before and would love to discuss this to see if there's anything we can do! Please contact your property manager or call the office at 217.328.3030 if you are interested in meeting with us.

review_text: We had an unexpected leak in our kitchen and Ben came right away to fix it. He quickly identified the possible causes and fixed them within an hour of arriving. He was courteous and gladly answered all of our questions.

Jeremy Klein was super helpful when my friend and I were looking for our apartment. He carefully considered all of our criteria for a living space and was very generous with his time (and his car) while showing us around all of the apartments.

My sink was clogged, I put in a request after business hours, and maintainace was there the next day! Stephen Mills, the maintance man, was a delight! Super nice,  courteous. He took the time to explain to me why my sink was clogged. It’s was a gross job, but he did it with a smile on his face. 5/5 Would recommend.

Campus Property Management is a complete joke. I lived at 606 E. Stoughton, which is one of their nicer locations. However, the appliances are extremely cheap and break easily, and when you request maintenance to fix something they show up a week later without any notice whatsoever. Being a girl, I felt completely uncomfortable in the shady parking garage. The lights down there are faulty, and there are NO surveillance cameras. The area surrounding was crime-ridden, and my roommate experienced two occasions in two months where her car was broken into or hit. I requested to CPM to install surveillance but they did not sound optimistic about the idea. I had my bike stolen from CPM maintenance, and they did absolutely nothing to contact me about it, and I doubt that they will reimburse me. Their customer service is terrible. They will 99 times out of 100 keep part of your security deposit for "cleaning" and "damages," even if you leave the place absolutely spotless. Do yourself a favor and stay away from these properties.

I lived with Campus Property Management for a while and in all situations was impressed with their services! Great response time to all requests and an overall pleasant experience. All staff were very polite and worked hard to find me a place that fit my needs. 10 out of 10 would recommend!
owner_response_text: We're so glad to hear you were happy with our services!

review_text:
I live off campus at Regency West in Champaign. CPM has both good and bad qualities, as with any other rental company. For example, maintenance does take quit awhile to respond to a request. However, if its an emergency such as no hot water or a broken front door lock, then they'll respond the same day or the next.

Nonetheless, the reason I renewed my lease with CPM is because of the affordable rent and my office management. Miguel, Candace & Maria (my current office manager) were all friendly and super helpful. Maria and myself have built a great relationship. I know that when I call or email her, she will always respond promptly. She's also very informative and one of the main reasons why I've decided to remain a tenant with CPM.

I worked with Jeremy Klein from CPM to acquire an apartment for the upcoming school year, and the service was amazing! He was extremely knowledgeable and definitely had my best interests in mind when looking for a place to live! I would recommend him if you are looking for a CPM apartment.

Just had maintenance done in my apartment on 52 armory and wanted to thank Bill Mannin for doing a great job. He was kind, quick, very professional and took the time to fix a few other issues around the apartment that I mentioned despite me not making a formal request through CPM.

CPM has reasonably priced apartments within walking distance to UIUC. When I moved in, the apartment was very clean. My property manager is Jeremy Klein, and he is very responsive to tenant problems and works very quickly to insure that the issues are resolved. He also showed me the apartment I will be moving into next year (still CPM, different location) and was very honest in answering all of my questions.

Despite their good qualities (lower rent, close to UIUC, good sized apartments), CPM is very aware that most of their tenants are college students. As such, some of the apartments are outdated and my complex's courtyard is frequently littered with trash from parties on the weekend. CPM also expects their tenants to be overly proactive in issuing complaints in order for things to be addressed (I have found that the best way to get anything done is to contact my property manger Jeremy instead of calling the main office. Jeremy is responsive to emails and does a good job taking care of issues).

CPM is also the only group I could find near campus that allows dogs (in some complexes). Overall, this has been a very positive experience for me. However, there are definitely some tenants who abuse this and never clean up after their animals. CPM has been working to correct this ever since I moved in, and I do appreciate their willingness to allow dog tenants.

I would only recommend CPM to college students who are willing to get slightly lower levels of customer service from the main office in exchange for cheaper rent. (Great for college kids, probably not great for families). Also, at least in my complex, the weekends are usually loud from the various college parties occuring, so you have to be okay with the noise levels. Though take this review knowing that I do like living with CPM enough that I am living with them next year, I am just switching to a smaller apartment complex.

CPM is absolutely terrible. Our washing machine has been broken for days, and they still haven't fixed it. At the beginning of the year, they tried to charge me $15 dollars to replace my key, even though my lock was already broken. On top of that, there are multiple things wrong with our apartment, including light bulbs that have gone out and not been replaced, air filter problems, and just problems with the walls in our shower. Even though we live on one of the nicer buildings, I would never recommend them to anyone. I would rather live an a dorm than live under CPM housing again. The base rent is not indicative of what you'll actually pay because they charge you so many ridiculous fees that they should not charge you in the first place. An example is our electric bill, they are charging me 2 $50 fees in the past two months for supposedly "not paying" the electric bill. Well I already have. Thanks, CPM for the terrible living experience.
owner_response_text: Hi Jayden. Someone was out today to fix the washer and should have it resolved tomorrow. We believe that there was no charges for the key replacement. Dwight will give you a call about the electrical bills and the fees.

review_text: I used to live with CPM a few years ago and recently inquired about looking into seeing some apartments. Megan was a great help! She was very knowledgable about the properties, very friendly, and attended to my every need. She did a great job in making sure all the things I wanted in an apartment I got. Thanks for your wonderful help!

Jay did a great job on helping me get the A/C back to work! He came in the morning and fixed it very quickly, so we do not need to suffer the high temp in the noon. Also he double checked to make sure the A/C is working well. Thanks a lot!

Have rented over year with CPM when I moved into town for a new job. They treated me with respect and outstanding professionalism. Always good with any needs. The Director and Managers are wonderful to work with.
owner_response_text: Thanks Leon, we're so glad to hear this!

review_text: At 606 E Stoughton. They're apartments only look nice when you tour them. Then you realize the quality of the apartment is all "refurbished" material that breaks after only a couple months of use. Management and maintenance do not help and need to be constantly reminded of your repair requests. Multiple cars were broken into (including my own) at this parking location at night. I have contacted property management more times than I've contacted Comcast about their internet service if that gives you an idea of how incompetent CPM is. I've even contacted CPM before about my concerns of safety at this property and how I don't feel like my car is safe and now my own car has been broken into. I would not even think about recommending CPM to anyone who is thinking about renting a property owned by them.

Jeremy Klein was great, showed me the apartment I'll be staying in next year and was straight forward and honest about everything we asked him.  He kept me updated to make sure I got the apartment I was looking at and was really the sweetest guy!

It's 95 today, and the air conditioner broke. CPM sent one of their repair guys, Bill Mannin, to repair it within the hour. The bad news: the circuit board was shot--something not repairable--and it's the Sunday of a three day weekend that's going to be in the upper 90s. No central air for three days! A disaster? No.

The good news: Bill was determined to do whatever he could to help us. He (and CPM) arranged for a portable air conditioning unit to be brought in. He set it up--ventilation, drainage, and all--ultimately saving me from days of heat-and-health related pain.  All of this on a holiday weekend Sunday, when I was honestly despairing of anyone even -being- here until Tuesday. CPM--and especially Bill--really came through for us. They went above and beyond to save us from misery. I highly, highly recommend them.

Water was leaking from our walls, ceiling, lights, air vents because of an apartment above us that had an overflowed toilet. We called emergency maintenance and Bill Mannin came in at two different times on a Sunday to help us out. He was very helpful and kind and answered any questions we had.

Edit: I posted this a week after GSR sold. I accidentally posted it to Hessels google account. So here you are! CPM has done in one week something Green Street Realty couldn't do in 12 months. Hessell On the Park  is now a fantastic place to live. Dustin was a literal Godsend. My fiancé and I were about to sign somewhere else until CPM came in and took over.

I wanted anyone and everyone to know , Hessel is now The Place To Live.
A company that cares. That hire people who care.

I was fortunate enough to have Ed Rice conduct the apartment showing. Ed was cordial throughout the experience, and answered all questions thoroughly. He was kind enough to drive my roommate and I to the CPM office, even with another showing scheduled after our own.

I have had a great 2 years renting from CPM! Kirsten Jeffrey was incredibly helpful in finding an apartment that met my roommates and my preferences. While with CPM, she has been very helpful and quick to respond to any of my questions!

I have lived with CPM for 2 years and  have had a good experience with them. Whenever I had problems with in my apartment, I would call them and the problem would be fixed shortly after.  Their receptionist, Amanda, was very friendly and always super helpful. I would recommend CPM for any student looking for a professional and friendly leasing company.

I was worried about the reviews but still ended up renting from CPM because of the location. I've lived here for about 2 months and here's my review thus far:

How they handled repairs:
-When I moved in my fridge was completely broken, would only blow hot air. I called CPM and they replaced it with a brand new one the next day.
-I rent a parking space in the garage under the building and there was a water leak which caused drywall/insulation to fall on my car and leave a residue on the paint. CPM paid for my car to be polished/waxed to remove it. (I would not recommend renting a space in this garage, the pillars make parking very tight and the spaces are painted to get as many cars as possible to fit. I've scraped my bumper on the wall since there is under 6 inches of clearance as you drive between a parked car and the wall. If you have a low car like mine, you will also scrape your exhaust on the ramp exiting the garage)

Cons
-When the fridge was replaced, there was a 12x12 inch patch of black mold hidden behind it which I did not know about until then
-The corner of the bathroom under the tub also had a rotting section covered in mold upon move in.

I'm a bit worried about my security deposit and if they'll charge me for issues that were there when I moved in but since it's signing season I thought I'd put this up now. Will update when I move out. (For reference I live at 408 Healey)
owner_response_text: Hi Brandon. We are sorry to hear about some of the issues you have had. We will be sending a maintenance technician to check on the mold in the apartment. Please let us know what we can do to help make your apartment more enjoyable.

review_text: I am currently renting through them and it has been nothing but issues. Our air conditioning broke and they did not get it fixed until 3 days later and it was in the 90's that week. There is an insane bug infestation issue. I have constantly contacted them and it took them over a week to put down any kind of trap. They never sprayed the place and they only put 2 sticky traps down, which to this day no bugs have touched, but they are still here. The place had a leak and it took days to get it fixed. The place was filthy when we moved in. The place also has mold, hard to breathe in here. I do not suggest any of their properties to anyone. Beware.

My daughter just moved in to a CPM property and already I am very impressed with how CPM handles maintenance requests.  Due to a poor and embarassing decision on my part, we had a broken deadbolt lock at 8 pm on a Friday.   We dealt with a very efficient and courteous after-hours rep who quickly dispatched my request to a maintenance professional.  Travis T.  (who lived 40 minutes away!) came right over and fixed the lock - and could not have been nicer.   Travis truly went above and beyond to help us on a Friday night and did it with a smile.  Although I hope not to need his services often, it is comforting to know that we can count on Travis and CPM.  Thank you!
The service is improved a lot in last two years. My fridge is broken today and  they sent Bill Mannin here in 30 mins. And he fixed everything quick and professional. This guy deserves a 5 star.

The maintenance request took a couple days to turn around, but when Bill Mannin stopped by, he had our washer fixed within less than 30 minutes! Highly satisfied, and the turnaround is most likely fault of management, or backed up requests.

I had a wonderful experience with CPM! Megan P was the main reason I had such a positive experience. She was very helpful, fun, and professional.  I would highly recommend this for team for all your apartment needs.

All in all Rafael Rodriguez was always very helpful. I experienced a few issues moving in my new apartment but he assisted and it was resolved fast. I’m very thankful for his help and his presence at CPM.
My AC wasn’t working and Stephen Mills solved the problem VERY FAST! Besides doing the job, he changed the filter (which was very dirty) and was very kind! Congratulations, I recommend his services!

From my experience with CPM, they always try their best to fix any problems that their tenants have in a timely manner. Maintenance requests are always handled in a timely and professional manner as well.
owner_response_text: We're happy to hear this, thanks for the feedback Dadabhvai!

review_text: CPM apartments are not fancy. They have crappy appliances which often break, are heated poorly, and are decorated with cheap furniture. That being said, I lived in a CPM apartment for 3 years, because it was the cheapest place on campus. I was perfectly happy to accept these difficulties because my rent was so much lower than it would be at another rental company. You should however factor in the cost of losing your entire security deposit. They will charge you for items that were broken/damaged before you even moved in. For example (stains on the carpeting, holes in walls, and broken box springs). I also had issues with cockroaches at one of the apartments. However, I had few issues with maintenance staff, they were always friendly. The bigger issues came from management not giving maintenance the proper equipment and staffing to keep all of the apartments in running order. If you don't care what kind of dive you live in, CPM is a deal. If you want quality, I would look somewhere else.

DO NOT rent from this company if you can possibly avoid it. My roommate and I live in the Cottage Grove apartments and will probably have to spend money working with the city or taking legal action, which is absolutely ridiculous and we don't want to waste time doing it, but the apartment is completely unsafe to live in. There is a list of issues that are completely unacceptable and unresolved.
1. We have BLACK MOLD in our apartment that makes the air unbreathable and can cause some serious illnesses. They are doing nothing about it. I reported a leak in the ceiling a month ago to which they responded "someone will be out immediately" and they never came. Myself and my roommate have since followed up on the phone, in person, and via email multiple times every week and NOBODY HAS EVER COME despite telling us that "someone will be there right away" or "someone will be there tomorrow". Now we have mold on the ceiling, in the carpet, in the walls, and a bathroom that is completely unusable and smells unbearably bad due to the mold. After trying to contact them so many times we were finally told "our maintenance crew is shorthanded and they are too busy". IT'S BEEN A MONTH and the ceiling is still leaking. Then they said a guy from PR (public relations I'm assuming) would come meet me. He never showed up. They would rather send someone to try and salvage their image before sending someone to work on the apartment.
2. We do not have access to our own mail and they are doing nothing to fix it. Again, same thing as the mold. Our keys don't work and even they can't get into our mailbox and they keep telling us "it will be fixed tomorrow" or "it will definitely be fixed by the end of the week" AND IT'S STILL NOT FIXED. We have meds sitting in our mailbox in the August heat that we don't have access to because they refuse to fix anything or help us get our mail. LUCKILY, all of our billing is online, but that doesn't change the fact that this isn't right.
3. They attempted to charge us twice the rent and a late fee for not paying this extra rent even though there is a paper trail stating that we paid EVERYTHING we were supposed to before we even moved in: the prorated rent for July, all of the rent for August, the sanitary fee for an entire year, our security deposit, and all utilities in our name (and the associated fees to turn them on). We paid all of this before moving in on July 22. Come August 1 we notice they say we didn't pay for August and they tacked on a late fee. I spoke to them on the phone and in person and they told me I was right and we shouldn't have to pay the second August rent like the online payment portal said we had to. But they "didn't know how to fix it", "didn't know who to call to get the charge removed" and it was on there for a while so we had to continue following up until it was resolved. That puts a ding on our credit score if it wasn't. If you live with them memorize your leasing agreement and check every single payment you have made or they will take money from you that you do not have to pay them.
3. Upon signing we were told that a list of things would be fixed and cleaned before we moved in. None of it was true. In fact, the apartment was DIRTIER when we moved in compared to when we toured it a month or two earlier. We cannot get rid of the cigarette smoke smell that pervades the apartment (smoking indoors is illegal in this building btw), there were wrappers and other various items scattered on the floor and in the dishwasher that made it look like someone had been squatting in the apartment, there was hair dye and personal products all over one of the bathrooms as if someone had just disguised themselves and were making a get away. The carpets were not cleaned, the walls were not painted, the bathroom fans were not fixed, etc... Additionally, one of the toilets didn't work and the sink in the same bathroom leaked water ALL OVER the place because the pipes were fitted with the COMPLETELY INCORRECT sizes.

There's more, but it exceeds character limits for review. DO NOT RENT FROM THEM.
Our food dispenser wasn’t operating correctly and within 24 hours of making the request, Bill showed up and fixed it. Fast, efficient, and friendly! Extremely satisfied with the quick service.
owner_response_text: We're so happy to hear you are happy with your service!

review_text: I lived with CPM for a year during college and I don't have any complaints. Any issues we did have were fixed in a good time and rent was pretty low for the area of campus I lived in. Kirsten was also helpful to work with.
Great maintenance from a wonderful maintenance tech Stephon Mills. He came to fix my A/C and done it very quick. Top of that he did it with a broken hand. He gave me a great motivation vibe.

If I can give a 0-star, believe me, I will choose it! CPM sucks. The only reason that you choose them is the rent is relatively cheaper -- not that much, actually. So my suggestion is DO NOT rent from them.

The place is totally crappy, the heater/microwave/restroom fan keeps broken and their maintenance department is the most terrible thing in the world: normally they come in 1-3 months after your reporting of the problem. What is worse, they normally do not fix things nicely, which means you need to call them again probably after a few months for the sample problems.

Oh about the winter, they just cannot come in time to get rid of the snow. They are not reliable at all!! If you call, they always say there's a truck on the way! The fact is, the damn truck never show up!! At last, I need to get a shovel and work on the parking lot myself with my roommate. It appears that the only thing they care is collecting rents from you -- and they are very efficient with that by the way.

Terrible company, again, if you care just a little about your life quality, DO NOT rent from them!!!

Jeremy helped me find my new apartment at a good price and with all the amenities that I wanted. He let me view the apartment with my roommate on our schedules and was happy to reschedule if we ever had a conflict in timing.

I can describe how disappointingly awful renting from this company has been.

1. They left us with BLACK mold covering three walls of our apartment for 1.5 months. We called, showed up in person begging them to fix it. Ultimately,  we had the health department come in to cite them with aggregious violations before they fixed anything.

2. We have been putting in maitenance requests for months and it took them 3 months and 4 repair efforts before we finally had a working dryer.

3. When they came in to fix some of the other violationa one of the two maitenance workers stole $50 off my roommates desk. Neither cpm nor one of the workers will admit to it. We have no recourse to get out money back because it is our word against theirs.

4. Whenever we called to bring up up issues 1-3, someone would always say that the property manager was in a meeting and would call us back by the end of the day. She has not called us back a single time, and we were forced to come in person every time before she would half heartedly handle our issue.

5. With all of the issues mentioned above we asked for some money off rent or some sort of compensation for our trouble because they had breached our contract multiple times. They refused to help us out.

Overall they both do not care for their tenants nor are they able to properly maintain a building. I have lived in the nasty dorms and a frat with better and more properly maintained living conditions. I am extremely low maintenance guy, but this was so absurdly poor that I had to write this review.
My roommate and I went to tour 309 John a few weeks ago.  Jeremy was our representative and he was very helpful.  We ended up signing a lease for an apartment there shortly after! Loved it.

It is a good experience living with CPM. Staffs are friendly. Our apartment manager Jeremy Klein is really nice and always helpful. Would recommend it if you are looking for a place to stay on campus.

It was worst experience dealing with the inefficient management, and I am writing this after signing the lease.  I was moved into the apartment and found out there is no refrigerator. It took 2 days to fix it.

There are insects dead and lying on the floor, It is their job to give a clean apartment. I wonder how they sleep night without doing their job right. I have been continuously following up  but no help.

Please if you are not serious about the real estate business don't do.
One day after requesting maintenance, Bill Mannin came and fixed problems with both the dishwasher and the fridge very quickly. He was also very friendly and helpful.
I met with Jeremy for my tour. He was great and explained in detail all about the apartment. He made the process very simple and easy for me. I would defiantly rent from cpm again!

Great experience with Bill Mannin, he came very quickly and was very helpful when our refrigerator was broken. He also went beyond what was needed and helped move things from our old fridge to the new one. Overall great man.

CPM agents really have a good ability to show and manage their apartments. One of them, who helps me many times, Jeremy Klein, shows me two buildings and several apartments until I finally find the best one for me. He also gives me lots of assistance after the show. Consequently, CPM is the place to go if you want to find an apartment.

Jeremy helped me find an apartment right when I was put in a rough situation in terms of my living situation next year. He made sure all of my questions were answered and even gave me more options I thought I had at the last minute! I recommend going to him if you're ever unsure where to live and just need advice. :)

The maintenance service is excellent. After a request for air conditioner diagnosis, the guy named Stephen Mills came for fixing it  and had all thing run in the right way at the first workday after we requested.

We came in to sign our apartment lease for the fall. We were helped by Daniel Shoemaker and he was great! He was really friendly and helpful and was able to answer our questions well. It was a great experience!

This is one of the nicest properties in Champaign-Urbana. We have a free gym membership with tons of amazing group fitness classes. A few months ago, we got all new stainless steel appliances and they are removing the carpets next because we have been here for 3 years. The staff are super friendly and our maintenance requests are always handled in a timely manner. The property we live at is great because it's enclosed and there is a security guard who patrols at night. We couldn't feel safer! I have lived in Chambana for 9+ years now and this is the longest I've lived in one place and my partner and I plan on staying for a while! They also have a cool Android VR app with the Oculus that allows you to see and experience available apartments.
We had a good experience with maintenance. Jack did a great job fixing our air conditioning system quickly and quite immediately.
owner_response_text: Thanks Lucy, we're happy to hear this!

review_text:
Moved in and there was garbage everywhere, cabinets and closet doors were broken, disposal was broken and clogged, the windows were covered in eggs. They purposefully don't put things into your lease that you agreed on before signing. This place is awful and recommend leasing from literally anyone else.

Update: They eventually got around to fixing most of these things after I wrote this review.

They have been prompt and extremely good on Maintenance Calls on the Rare Occasion I Have One!

Stephen and All the Guys Working Hard in these difficult Times are First Rate!

Urbana Michigan Location.

Thanks Again!

I would rather be homeless than ever living with CPM again. Their staff is rude and they are a mess. I ask 1 question and I get 5 different answers. You make 1 maintenance request and it takes 5 more to actually fix the problem. The things they charge on the security deposit are a joke and outrageous. CPM IS HORRIBLE.
owner_response_text: Hi Leila! We are more than happy to answer the questions or concerns you may have with the damage and cleaning charges from your apartment at any time. You can reach us at 217.328.3030 or through LiveChat on our website. Have a nice day!

review_text: Bill Mannin came and fixed my stove. My landlord Maria is amazing, our neighborhood is so nice. Wish we could fence in the yard for the pup, but we understand! We have been with CPM for years.

I wish I could give this place no stars.

I moved into a kind of scary looking old building, but still a little charming. That's fine, some houses in Urbana are a little creepy looking. But the inside was awful when I moved in, and was a continuing issue.

When I moved in, the toilet was broken, there was a serious spider infestation, the tile was coming up off the floor, there was the smell of dried old urine from years past. Not only that, but the stovetop was completely rusted away from the oven - in other words, you could literally pick up the stovetop. And once you picked it up, there was a wasp's nest on one of the burners.

They took 2 days to fix the toilet, and two weeks to fix the stove. They replaced it, but then the new stove had a gas leak, which of course is a serious issue for myself and my service dog (yes, these people take advantage of people with disabilities).

After repeated attempts to contact my "property manager", I was given the cold shoulder and
informed that they were working on some type of solution. This solution was not found until a week after I have moved in. Finally, they got a working stove installed. It had a gas leak as well, which took them another day to fix. I had to tell the maintenance fellow how to fix the gas leak (you have to use teflon tape instead of regular caulk).

Fast forward one week, I come home to a bat flying around in my apartment on a Saturday night, a guano all over the floor and my bed. I get the bat out of the apartment, call emergency maintenance. All they do is come out with a little kid's bug net in hand to see if the bat is there, which it wasn't, and then they leave. Tuesday, Property Manager decided to call me about the bat situation, and offers to terminate my lease since CPM had violated it several times to begin with. I decided that I had been through so much already that it'd be fine, things can't get worse. I'll just stay in the apartment.

Well, my friends...

It took 2 weeks for someone to come out and bat-proof the apartment. And I mean two weeks after Property Manager claimed to have put in a maintenance request and I had called several times putting in a new request each time.

And guess what! The night after they "bat-proofed", I came home to find another one flying around my apartment! And right around this time, the smell of decaying bat flesh was coming out of one of the walls

This company lives off of taking advantage of people who are renting from far away. I signed my lease while living in Texas, and decided to trust their word and trust in common decency that the apartment would be livable when I got to Urbana. They tried to take my money and run, and pretend that the issues they shoved onto me didn't actually exist. This company does not care about your well being or basic living rights as a human. They might be cheap, but there is a good reason for that. DO NOT RENT FROM THESE CROOKS. I don't know why the Tenant's Union doesn't do anything to shut down their criminal operation which takes advantage of international students. BUT TAKE IT FROM ME: THIS IS NOT WORTH IT. FIND ANOTHER PLACE THAT'S SLIGHTLY MORE EXPENSIVE. The extra money for a slightly more expensive place pays for your peace of mind and a stable environment to live in.

Nothing is worth living in a slum, dealing with a company that ignores your basic human rights like access to a toilet, and safety for people with disabilities. Do not give them you or your parents' hard earned cash. Trust me.

Dakota Ruff was very informative and was excellent at communicating with us. He answered all of our questions thoroughly and always responded quickly. Because of him we have a had a good experience with CPM so far.

Madison Herbett was really helpful to show us the apartment around beyond her working hours as well. She kept patient and showed us the apartment multiple times, and brushed us with multiple options within our requirements. Thanks Madison for helping us to finalise our apartment. :))

Had an awesome experience with maintenance! We called yesterday with an issue and a maintenance guy named Jay came very quickly and fixed everything as soon as possible. The experience was very pleasant!

Don't use CPM, especially not to park at 905 Oregon. Last year, the entire garage flooded and most cars were totaled. They notified me of the flood the next day and did not even pay for the books that were ruined, let alone compensate me for the two months spent without a car/new car. I could not get out of the contract or reimbursed for the ginormous inconvenience. The garage was a wreck for months until I called the city. They do not disclose the flood to prospective customers, so BEWARE! Bad bad bad
Every time I’ve had to put in a maintenance request Ben has been very helpful! He’s always super friendly and provides great tips for fixing things around the apartment.

The apartments at East Michigan are great value for money and close to some great facilities in Urbana. Our maintenance issues have always been taken care of satisfactorily and in a timely manner- Travis does a great job!

CPM has been a great company to lease with. The property manager for my building, Dakota, has been especially helpful through the whole leasing process. Going above and beyond for any question or concern. I highly recommended living at CPM!

Bill Mannin did an excellent job finding the problem problem with our AC, and was able to fully fix it in no time. He also gave great advice on ways to prevent future problems with our AC. I really appreciate the help from Bill.

If I could give them 0 I would.

My apartment was one step away from being condemned by the city of Champaign, and the only reason it was not is because I stopped the process because CPM said they wouldn't provide accommodations once it was condemned.

The apartment was DISGUSTING when my roommates and I moved in. Pubic hair in the bathroom sink, in the medicine cabinet, and on the mattresses. The kitchen was dirty, the sink was leaking, causing mildew to grow in the cabinet, and the carpeting in the lofted common area was black and saturated with what smelled like cat urine. When CPM told us the carpeting should be beige, someone came out to "clean" the carpet, and left it the same way it was when they came in. CPM argued that it was fine, for weeks until they came out and replaced it. During the winter, the apartment was 45 degrees even with all of the exterior doors and windows covered with plastic twice. When this was brought up with CPM, the owner of the company came by multiple times and said nothing was wrong because the thermostat was reading 70 degrees. This issue was never fixed. There were animals getting in to the walls of the apartment from a hole on the roof, and when maintenance was informed of this issue, they came by 3 times and said that nothing was wrong, and that we were crazy. When animal control got involved, they found multiple squirrel nests around a hole near the corner of the roof.

It's easy to look at these reviews and want to stay away, but CPM manages LOTS of property and people are more inclined to leave reviews of their bad experiences.  In reality, I am certain that there is a silent majority of satisfied customers - like myself.  I lived with CPM during my sophomore year (at 506 W Elm St) and my senior year (at 106 S Gregory St).  In my experience: CPM has been quick to respond to maintenance requests, maintains property premises well (as far as snow cleaning, etc goes), and is generally accommodating with payment issues (within reason).  CPM is certainly headed in the right direction: they seem to be remodeling many units as well, and offering good deals on them (like at 106 S Gregory).  Edward Rice was a great property manager, with constant and prompt communication; he was nice and always very professional.  For affordable living close to campus, CPM is frankly hard to beat.

I have never written a review before so I hope this shows how much I hate CPM. Always hang up when you call in to ask a question relating to your apartment or account. Never come to do maintenance on the apartments when asked to do so. Terrible service. I hate you guys. CPM has worse service than a banana trying to answer the phone. I would rather ask a banana to help me with my account services or ask it questions about my apartment. I would rather have a banana pull up in the banana-mobile and come in with his tiny toolbox to fix our apartment. And last of all, I would rather you not pick CPM if you were given a choice.

review_text:
I would give GSR 0 stars if I could. This is by far the worst property management company in Champaign/Urbana.

It's 1°F outside with a strong winter storm of the season! The HVAC system of the building went down since early morning. I called the emergency maintenance number (at 8 am), and they told me they are making some repairs to get the heat back on asap. It's been more than 8 hours (5 pm) and still no heat! My apartment has been as cold as outside in this horrible storm for more since early morning and I feel like I have all the cold symptoms now!

However, I asked GSR this morning for a temporary electric heater, they said the boilers will be back soon! Maybe in their world, "soon" means a couple of weeks after!

In summary, if you want the worst shady maintenance and customer service, do business with this company! They do very shady business, very unprofessional, and terrible maintenance and the only thing they care about is money.

My property manager, Katherine Taylor, was very kind, responsive, and helpful when a problem did occur, and she took care of it professionally. I would recommend this apartment complex to friends and family.
My roommate and I have been living at Field South for almost three years and have had a great experience living there. The property manager, Amy, is the BEST! Definitely recommend this property.

I would give GSR 0 stars if I could, I had to get a lawyer involved regarding my issues due to their extreme greed, lying, and cunningness. Almost lost thousands of dollars. They don't respond to urgent work orders, their staff is rude, and there is absolutely no regard for tenants. They do not honor amenities as promised in the lease, our only dryer in building has been broken for a week now with no word, called today they're still "waiting on a part" BS. review_text:
Be very careful if you want to rent a place with Green Street Realty (GSR). So our ordeal begins when we went to view a remodeled unit on White St, Champaign and the leasing agent was very welcoming and said the apartment was pet friendly (nothing was mentioned about any size limit) and everything will be completed by August 20, our move in date. He even went onto say the utilities were all inclusive (they still advertise it as such as evident from the attached screenshot). Our first warning sign was that on the day of signing  the lease, he texts us and says apparently he had the wrong information and the electricity and water is the tenant's responsibility. We were taken aback by this sudden change but still opted to go ahead with the unit as it is very close to our workplace.

So, on the day of our move-in, the first thing we find is that the main door hasn't been replaced yet. It was still the same old ugly door, full of scratches and holes.  The air-conditioning was probably from the stone-age with enough dust on it to make you fall sick (picture attached). They took around a month or so to replace both (only after the 2nd monthly rent was paid). We weren't even informed when they will come to replace the main door. My wife was in the middle of a zoom meeting when someone literally started breaking the door, locking both of us inside the apartment. In addition to this, the bedroom windowpane and cabinet came off the day we moved into the unit (again took an entire week to fix them).

My wife was planning to adopt an ESA. We really liked a dog at our local animal shelter, and everything was more or less taken care of apart from the shelter people calling GSR. The receptionist at the GSR office apparently told the shelter personnel that the apartment is only for small dogs / cats (again, nowhere mentioned in the lease agreement). When my wife gave GSR a call about this, she was told to get an ESA approval letter and once they do a background check on it, they will give the green signal to the shelter. Of course, this takes time and by the time my wife submitted documents to GSR, the ESA she wanted was no longer available. Nevertheless, the GSR leasing department confirmed they have my wife's record in their system and if they get another such call about an adoption, they will approve it.

A week later, my wife got in contact with another adoption center (this time for a 2-month old puppy) and again, GSR told the shelter home that pets are not allowed in our unit. Interestingly enough, they are still trying to rent out these units as pet friendly, for Fall 2021 (screenshot attached from their website). My wife called GSR once again and the receptionist started accusing my wife of not showing any ESA approval and also, they can apparently change the terms of the lease whenever they want as far as pets are concerned (keep in mind, this is not a case of a pet at the property being violent to another person). When my wife pointed out to the fact that the GSR leasing department already has her ESA letter and they have already forwarded her a GSR animal leasing document, the receptionist (realizing the mistake) started making excuses that their system wasn't updated yet (apparently there is no communication between the leasing department and the reception) and told us to make the shelter call them once again. These rejections basically end up blacklisting my wife at the shelter homes, who will not want to deal with problematic property managers.

Be very careful if you are planning to consider GSR properties as your next address. My suggestion, find someplace else.

Worst leasing company on campus. Signed for two years and their property is always damaged easily. They drag to fix properties and one time it almost took them a whole month to fix our dryer. They also overcharge for electricity. Also, they never fix your maintenance requests until you annoy or threaten them. There's always something wrong with this company please don't sign with them.

However, the customer support is really poor . They can be short-tempered and blunt when you call them. Also, sometimes the pest control technicians will randomly knock on your door in the morning and come in without permission or prior notice.
