They often show your unit with very short notice (at most 24 hours), and they give the current tenants no priority (i.e. a set time frame to renew). That being said, if someone is interested in your unit eight months before your lease ends, they will just let them sign the new lease without even notifying you. Super messed up!

-"scattered" management style: I've never seen such management before, but they just seem to be a group of leasing agents that change all the time, every time you contact them, you get a new name. And the team members don't seem to communicate with each other either. There is practically no manager for any given property. Their top and only priority seems to be GETTING AS MANY LEASE SIGNED AS POSSIBLE, and once you are locked in a lease, their job is done. Fantastic. Lol.

Very poor management. ! One of my relative student at UIUC stays at 201 west green street. They signed a two bed two bath apartment with in house laundry facilities. Before signing the lease, the entire house was shown by the leasing agent and the video had the laundry washer and dryer. But when they moved in , there was no laundry facility in the house. Since more than 50 days they don't have washer and dryer. The management do not respond to emails. Every time one has to go to their office. My relative and their friend has been to office almost 15 times and each time there is a false assurance that the washer and dryer will be installed in a 2-3 days time.

The people at the reception are not efficient. They don't know what time the manager comes to the office and email are hardly responded to. There is no way one can know when can they talk to the manager.

My roommate and I just signed a lease for one of newest properties. Although some parts are still under construction, we really enjoy living there so far! The construction workers are respectful and friendly. And our property manager Jourdan Cohen is accountable, responsive, and shows great hospitality. We are glad that we got to move here!

Dealing with this company has been an absolute nightmare. There has been blatant lying and unprofessionalism displayed by almost everyone I have interacted with. When touring apartments to sign for, the employee that was trying to get us to sign completely lied by offering free parking "across the street" to sweeten the deal. This parking spot was not across the street, but rather multiple blocks down. After one of us followed up on the spot and caught her in the lie, she said "well you know, in that area".

Multiple times when the singular elevator that operates in the apartment has gone down, I have attempted to use the staircase to leave the apartment, but the door has been jammed and is not openable, which is a huge fire hazard. When I emailed about this, I was completely ignored.

I have been hung up on three times in a row when calling about my car being towed from their free lot. My car was towed away due to their mistake of uploading someone else's parking lease on to my portal. When submitting a ticket to have my own lease uploaded so that I can see what parking spot I am, the ticket was marked complete but ignored. When I called the office to ask about where I should park, I was told to park in the open spot next to my roommate's, as that one "was mine". After not being to my car for two weeks, I have just found out that it has been towed as that spot is not actually mine, and I now have over an $800 charge to get my car back. But not once, even after the tow being THEIR fault, was I told that they had their towing company remove my car. After being hung up on three times when calling to resolve this charge, as it is not my fault and I do not have the money to pay for it and am in need of my car, I asked if there was anyone else that I may speak to. I was ignored and told no. I am exploring legal action as I will not be paying $800 to get my car back due to their error. Everyday I do not have my car I am losing money.

After all of these experiences, I have learned that this company is extremely unprofessional at handling whatever requests that you may have. They have not even once replied to an email that I have sent about apartment showings and nothing will get done regarding apartment maintenance unless you show up in person to the office. I will be escalating my complaints to whoever is managing these employees and warn any prospective tenants that if they sign here they will be dealing with unresponsiveness, unprofessionalism, and downright lying. If you want to be sure that you do not have to pay surprise $800 towing bills and require physical attendance to resolve issues, then it's a good idea to look for another spot to live.

They pressure you to renew your lease almost 8 months before your previous one is done. When you do not immediately meet their demand, they start having showing your space  almost every two weeks. They should consider reserving model apartments, so they do not keep disturbing their tenants personal space. For that alone, I have made the decision to look elsewhere for next year.

I moved into a unit owned by Green St Reality when I first moved to C-U over a year ago. As I got to know people in the community, all of them told me that Green St Reality was the worst leasing agency in the area. As my time with them went on, I realized why. So I originally had given a Green Street Realty a 5-star review, because I think they really deserved it. However, after over a year in my unit, I'm downgrading them because their overall service has declined significantly.

The bottom line: Green Street Realty probably isn't worthy of your business. The rent that you pay isn't worth the service you receive. I expect either a higher quality of management, or a lower cost of renting a unit, but the prices are above average and the service is below it.

One of my biggest complaints now is that the maintenance is wildly varied in skill level, and very rarely reliable. It often takes them days to stop by, whether the issue is something small or more serious. On top of that, the quality of repairs is usually lacking the attention to detail they once had. Not long ago, I needed some maintenance work done on my in-unit washer and dryer. One other thing that really frustrates me is the clear lack of interest in maintaining or improving their "non-flagship" properties. I live in a simple unit just off campus, and any time I request any sort of lasting improvement be made to the property, I'm met with either resistance or apathy. For example, before moving in, I requested that they have fiber internet lines run to the units, a process that would be 100% FREE to them, and they told me that "nothing could be done to the units."

On another occasion, I wanted to chat with someone about making some improvements to the landscaping at the property, which has an ugly south wall that looks naked and dirty because no grass grows within a foot of the building. They could have made a small, one-time investment into some low-maintenance flowering shrubs/bushes to really brighten up the property (and maybe even the general area), plus the cost of a bit of upkeep over the years, but they wouldn't humor that, either. I understand that these things might take planning or other issues may preclude them from doing anything, but I never received anything beyond a "No, sorry" in the way of explanation.

Not the worst property management company I’ve had to deal with in Champaign, but my experience as a resident at 112 Green was by no means “good”, especially for the price you pay:

1. Most recently was charged upwards of $1000 in cleaning/painting/trash removal fees during move-out. While some of these fees are understandable due to regular wear and tear, these charges were grossly disproportionate to the amount of actual “damage” present — the only reason things were left in the unit is due to a family emergency that resulted in my roommate not having enough time to fully move out (management was informed ahead of time, but was not very understanding in offering a move-out extension and chose to charge me and my roommate over a grand EACH). It does NOT cost $625 in labor or material to dispose of things left in the apartment (which we would have properly disposed of, had management had an OUNCE of empathy to give my roommate an extension). $200 for a “full-unit paint repair” due to a few scuffs is ridiculous (and again, this is PER PERSON).

2. There is no sense of safety security in the building or immediately outside the building (which is concerning due to the close proximity to the crowd attracted by the liquor store and Kams). One of the doors would frequently not close properly, allowing random people to enter freely. As a result I’ve had packages go missing, and food/grocery orders stolen. Parking lot is a free for all which isn't great - there's no real surveillance, my car was broken into once and I regularly found customers of the liquor store sitting on or using the roof of my car as a table.

3. Elevator was broken more than a handful of times and would often take more than 24 hours to be fixed (Wasn’t able to move out properly because my roommate and I had to carry all of our belongings down 5 flights of stairs which was convenient for First Column because they could charge us fees for not moving out properly, also carried groceries up 5 floors on several occasions).

4. Management did not follow or enforce their own COVID policy upon being identified as an outbreak site which was to provide hand sanitizers at every entrance - a bottle was placed there once, and NEVER replaced afterwards.

5. General inconveniences that should not be happening considering how much rent is — there is no garbage shoot, so you have to haul your garbage down and outside to a dumpster (which was regularly overflowing). Appliances aren’t the best, dishwasher regularly smelled bad despite several visits from maintenance. Always felt like management was "out to get me" during periodic unit inspections (always had a bad attitude about everything).

I had a great experience signing a lease with First Column Student Living. I will be living at 512 E. Green St next year and the process was very straightforward and clear. The leasing agents were friendly and made it possible for my friends and I to get a discount with a group deal. The apartments at 512 are very nice for the price I am paying and the location is great too. I cant wait to be a part of the First Column community!

I am living at 907 Third St next year and First Column made the application process so quick and easy for me. They answered my calls quickly and when I toured the leasing agent was able to answer my questions and give me a lot of useful information. First Column’s properties are very nice and their price is great. Their staff also communicates very effectively. Overall, I’m really looking forward to living here next year

They have terrible customer service, I paid my rent on the 1st when it's due and they claim to have not seen it until 5 days later. Charging me an absurd late fee. There is no grace period for rent, they post it on the 1st and it is due by midnight the 1st. The alarm in 112 is constantly going off and they can never get anyone to stop it.
owner_response_text: Hi Sonia, we are sorry to hear you have not had a good experience with our office. Our late fee policy has not changed. Late fees have always been posted on the 2nd. Regarding the alarm, this has been addressed. If it continues to go off, please call the office to let us know.

review_text: I came in a rush trying to get situated for school, but the management was very helpful and *quick* with any issues that I had. The apartment themselves are great, with a spacious living room and kitchen with two fridges, which is great for 4 bedroom apartments. My only complain is that their supplied furniture for the bedrooms can be inefficient with the space, but they're still nice to have.

I don’t have any complaints about living under First Column Student Living. They are very responsive to the emails I send them and someone always is available for me when I call. They are very good about maintenance requests and get them done as soon as possible in a professional manner. I haven’t had any problems yet.

**212 E Green St**
The building is nice but the staff is the opposite. A few experiences below:
-I had a horrible incident in which a group of friends and I were stuck on this elevator for several hours. We were billed over $900 to repair the elevator, which really should be the responsibility of the building. They will argue and say we did something wrong - BUT we have yet to see any claimed footage/proof of such -- and I heard from other residents of the same building that the same thing happened to them!
I truly felt like we were being taken advantage of and, most importantly, they were unpleasant throughout the whole process. Definitely an uncomfortable feeling that you don't want to feel while coming "home" to your building every day.
They started getting shady about the payment of this elevator fee. They tried to evict me for "not paying my rent" because I had not yet paid this charge (but my rent fee was paid). They were well aware I was working with a lawyer because I didn't feel like this was my fault.. eventually I gave in in fear of the eviction notice (you won, it worked) and they rushed me to pay by 5:00pm that day (it was already 4PM) or else I would face "more fees" ---  what college student do you know has more than $400 on hand? I had to take out a money order at the post office across the street.
-I signed my lease electronically, and the leasing agent was very pushy. She said I had to sign tonight to get this certain deal (as oppose to waiting to have my parents look over the contract) but she did ensure that by signing that day I would receive a free pair of beats headphones! This made my ears perk up of course but unfortunately I never received them. I followed up several times while living there some said that the agent (Maria) wasn't working there anymore and everyone claimed to not know what deal I was speaking of (it wasn't random because they give away beats headphones all the time...)

-Anyways, if you have the slightest issue or head bump with the management, they become super cold and unfriendly. As I said, I am living under their roof, so the hostility really sucked and made me never want to be around my own building. I totally understand that this is a "society" we live in, but it's also a college campus. I wouldn't expect to receive such treatment at a five-star apartment in Chicago, let alone a student living facility in Champaign. Seems like more residents I talked to also agreed about this feeling.

The building and the amenities are honestly super nice. I would love if this place had all new staff or the company was shut down and the building run by a new one.

I love to live here! The facilities provided to me were brand new and the people who live in the apartment are very friendly. Besides I can study in the study room of our apartment, which made it very convenient especially in winter. I do enjoy the first column living experience!
The maintenance here was very helpful and responsive. The apartments look great as well as the amenities. In general, a good environment. Definitely a great apartment for its value!

I really enjoy living here! I feel safe within this building and the rooms aren’t the largest but perfect for me and my roommates! Maintenance is also very responsive to our work orders, so that’s a plus!

Don’t trust them. They are sexist and they don’t apologize. They also vandalized the campus with spray painted ads. They delete all the bad reviews.

Yes, you helped me by telling me that if my husband was a slob and made me do every single thing that I would HAVE TO LIVE WITH IT. That helped me so much. Thanks for being sexist. And thanks for calling sexism professional! What a joke.

Have nothing but trouble with these people.  Nice place.  Great location.  No way to get out of contract for any reason after you sign.  Staff enter the apartment with no notice.  And not for maintenance reasons either.  Had a fire on above floor and haven't cleaned up our floor yet.  Don't rent from this company.

I have lived with First Column for the past two years at 112 E Green. Overall, the building is great, the maintenance is quick, and the staff are polite. However, one complaint I have is that they force you to utilize SimpleBills to pay for utilities which comes with a monthly fee that is charged to everyone living in the apartment.

212, The apartments look nice but cheep furniture and the window leaks when it rains! The gym is always dirty, half the machines don't work right and needs maintenance. Raised rates and it's now way over priced and not worth it. Terrible wifi! Blinds in the gym are even broken the chest press hasn't worked right in months.

512 Green: location is great and the staff is nice and friendly. However, the waste management is horrible: no chute, no dumpster, and no recycling bins. There are only four always-full regular sized bins (all lids are broken). Also, the noise level is pretty bad during the weekend.

Lived at 212 E green the first semester it opened. When our 5 month lease ended we checked our accounts and had tremendous fines for "Elevator damages" from a time we got stuck in their elevators for too many people. They sent us a direct bill from the elevator company and insisted we pay. We did nothing but use our amenities of the elevator and were accused when it stopped between floors. Also, when after receiving 1 warning for a noise complaint, we were fined 600$ for the instance. Would not recommend living here unless you want to be taken advantage of.

Awful costumer service. All buildings will constantly damaged inside and out. Elevator was out of date the entire time I lived there and kept sounding like it was going to break. Whenever I would call to say someone was parked in my spot they would come back with a rude remark and send not only myself but my mom an email and be extremely unprofessional. Worst apartment complex I have ever lived in.

My main gripe with this location is that the internet is of a poor quality, not due to any technical issues, but because first column pays for a low bandwith. It is unacceptable that the internet at their 512 location, which costs much more than their other locations, is of a lower quality. Once this is fixed, they will have a 5 star rating
Personally, I love the location of my building and I like how quick and responsive the first column team is. It is my first time living in one of their facilities, and I can honestly say it’s great.

my suitemates & i are so looking forward to living with first column.. we looked all over the place for apartments & we knew as soon as we found first column that it would be the place for us!! perfect location right in the heart of campus life & overall great value. cheers to first column!!

The apartments are priced appropriately for where they're located, the amenities and how spacious they are. The staff is always so helpful! They also have giveaways and free food pretty much every week.
I've had nothing but good experiences with First Column. The unit I have is very nice, large, and appliances are very new. The property is a bit pricey, but it is worth it in my opinion.

112 E Green '16-17.
2 stars for the following:
(1) leasing office was disorganized & leasing agent lied to me. When I was supposed to move in early & I had called them 4 hrs ahead of time to let them know when I was arriving, they acted surprise when I got there & took 40+ mins to get me my keys. I found it frustrating since they took my check for the deposit/rent & I had to wait specifically for Michelle, GM, to come back and do a background check on my co-signer, which they couldn't do in the first place since they didn't ask for his SSN & Jona, secretary, eventually did it in front of me. Also, when I signed my lease it was promised I would receive a covered parking spot & a 5F apartment. I asked them for an updated lease with everything requested & I never received it. I have lived in the Midwest my entire life, so if I knew there was no covered spots, I would not have signed. However, as I made friends in the building, I found out before the property had switched from Roland to First Column Living (FCL), all covered parking spots were given away by 01/2016. Because another girl was denied covered parking when she requested one in January. I signed the Summer of 2016. When I was denied the spot, they told me another agent had signed the last one before me in May.  Both things were not given to me & Anthony promised he would clean off my car when it snowed, which I did not expect to happen. But, please do not promise me things if you cannot keep them or lie to me.
(2) I had a displeasing conversation on the phone with maintenance that my dog peed in the hallway, but I urged them to actually look at the footage. Since, I clean up after my dog if he had an accident in common areas & the mess was not pee but leaked garbage juice. He never called back so I'm assuming that they actually looked that time & realized it was a different tenant's garbage
(3) They align themselves with services that charges students extra. SimpleBills (SB) charges students $8 for using a check or $12(?) for using a credit card when paying for utilities. I found this REALLY weird since SB is simply using Ameren & Ameren does not charge you any money for using a check to submit payment. Also because SB is located in TX (I tried bypassing the service fee to send them a check) & when I searched them last year their Google/Facebook reviews were in the gutter (~2.5/5.0), which somehow disappeared this year. After doing some research, I found out FCL & other properties who use SB gets paid a percentage of the service fees that STUDENTS pay to SB & FCL does not have to pay any service fees for using SB. Yes, I understand that SB allows you to split things evenly among roommates, but SB requires EVERY roommate to make an account. Therefore, each STUDENT has to pay at least $96+ in service fees. So I only recommend SB if you are rooming with random people. Also, their contract with Feldkamps, towing company, allows them to patrol all lots to tow whenever if you do not have your parking tag up (This is in the lease agreement though, but I find it weird because you should be able to simply call the towing company when someone is in your spot). Even though FCL takes down your car information, I guess it's not relayed to the towing company as they will still tow your car when you don't have the tag. Which makes me wonder why FCL takes the info.They also contracted last year with Feldkamps to salt their parking lots. I noticed they only salted, whenever I called to let them know the parking lot was still icy.
A fair warning to residents with support animals, FCL may ask for you to provide a certificate, a letter from a doctor, and a copy of the support animal ID card. According to the Fair Housing Act, you only need to provide a letter from a doctor.
2 reasons why I gave them 2 stars instead of 1: Jona & the people who work upfront are nice and will help you the best they can. Though I had one bad encounter with the maintenance people, they took care of the ice in the parking lot when Feldkamps couldn't and made the hallways sparkle and smell clean weekly

Facilities are good by any standard. 212 East has grills and more in the courtyard. Management recently started addressing noise which is nice. Minus one star until we get the Joe's cover we were promised.

Great apartment looks wise, but there is no respect of privacy. Management comes in randomly. Security knocks on your door at 12:00am for smells of marijuana in the hall way. Also, some of the aspects of the contract is sketchy.

The leasing agents and staff are wonderful! A few that stand out would be Michelle, Anthony, Tyler and Maria! Love getting to see them often! I always get greeted and always have great conversations with them! I am looking forward to the tv's getting wired internet so I can continue to watch Netflix without so many interruptions! Also love all the events with free food! Hopefully there are more that happen when im actually available! But overall love living here! (:

DON'T SIGN WITH FIRST COLUMN. Its a trap that you will regret. The apartment is nice but the furniture are cheap and will starts to fall apart in just a few month. the management are DISRESPECT and VERY RUDE. they do not understand what student living means. They have a lot of unnecessary fees that you will be unaware about when signing. and enter your apartment whenever they want.

Very misleading when it comes to unit assignments. They have a strange system of not assigning units for a certain building at the time of lease signing, instead you jot down your preferences regarding floor number and position and they assure you that you'll get a unit meeting those criteria.

Well, my roommate and I went in to tour a two bedroom at 112 where we found out that the units on the second and third floor have a sizeable amount more square footage than the other floors. We asked the employee showing us the unit how many units were left on the 2nd and 3rd floor (this was before learning how units and assigned) and she sent a text to her manager to ask. After 10 minutes of awkward small talk she apparently got a reply stating that there was a handful left. Looking back this doesn't make any sense because if rooms aren't assigned at signing the lease then we must have been lied to.

Fast forward a day and we go in to sign, assuming that we would get one of the larger units was a key point in deciding to sign with them. Since all the two bedrooms were the same price and we checked the availability we felt certain that we would get one. We were caught off guard when we learned that signing doesnt lock in a specific unit but were assured that if we wrote our preference down it would happen.

Now it's August and we've been assigned to a room on the 4th floor despite making every effort to get one on the other half of the building. Explaining our situation to them resulted in "unfortunately there's nothing we can do".

Misleading. Dishonest. Rude. Privacy concerns. None of the apartments have a garbage disposal, ice on windows, furniture is broken and an ugly yellow color. Really terrible customer service and they are very unprofessional in terms of confidentiality with residents. Rookies in living spaces because they clearly don't know what they're doing.
They offer great amenities (free printing and free breakfasts) and all of their complexes are in good locations. The buildings are secure and maintenance is really fast.

I have been living here for about half a year and the response rate of maintenance is the best I have ever received. They’re very adaptable and will fix things no later than a day after the request is in.
Wow! Such a nice place. They always have super cool events (which include food). In the 3 years I've lived in on campus apartments this has been my best experience thus far.

This is my first and only review, and I hope that it serves as a warning to residents (so that you know what you're getting into):

My roommates and I are very disappointed with our year at 512 Green Street. We were treated unfairly throughout the entire first semester and much of the second semester, as we were constantly charged with fines and fees.

Living above a bar (Legends) made the environment constantly loud, yet the few times that our apt played music somewhat loud in the early evening, we were fined at a large cost ($150 each tenant). The management was not forgiving or understanding on any occasion.

Also, despite being away for most of the second semester because of Coronavirus, we ended up being charged significantly for minor damage in each room, and the small amounts of garbage left behind.

God forbid you get a payment in late or lose a cheap key fab -- first column will bill and threaten you with legal action for even the smallest issue. Cheap chairs that broke (got charged), cheap coffee table (got charged), cheap couch--almost everything except for the fridge space and my roommates was negative.

If you stay here for a year, you'd have to be an angel to avoid any fines or issues with management.
The staff were very friendly and the office did many fun giveaways throughout the year. The maintenance staff was also very quick and friendly as well.
Great place for students to live. Clean amenities, updated appliances, and a courtyard great for entertainment. Perfect place to succeed in school and enjoy your time as a college student.
212 Green has been great so far. Staff has been friendly and accommodating. Apartments and amenities are nice. Great location.
We just moved our son into an apartment here.  Friendly and courteous office staff, great service, very clean apartment, immediate  response to work-orders.
love the free food and cool place to live, sometimes not a lot of privacy, but great place and ok people. WiFi is decent and good amenities, good place to live

Been living with them for 2 months. No major problems and you get what you pay for (at a reasonable price).

I recommend
Super clean and spacious apartment. The residents are friendly and the management is great!
Some apartments have rooms without windows... and elevators are broken too often.
They are very unfriendly and charge you $50 if you lock yourself out of the room. They also won't provide you a second key.
Worst Management to deal with on campus. Cheap furniture. All their five star were given by their own staff.
Nice apartments, very friendly staff, and they have free food a lot
The tour was really great and the staff answered a lot of questions, just think the place is a little overpriced without some of the amenities
Nice apartments. Caring employees that are always willing to help.
Very friendly staff in a modern new facility. Great events, free food, and amenities!
Nice but a bit loud because of location! Overall fun place to live!
So far so good!! The staff is very friendly and they always have different social events & specials going on.
The good people at 512 have been an awesome help with getting everything in order for my apartment next year!!!!!!
First column has great customer service and always makes me feel appreciated as a resident!
Great experience with the housing staff. Love the comfort and the amenities provided.
Nice, modern building with a lot of amenities. Only a 10 minute walk from the quad.
I love living here ! They always give you free food. :)
I love loving here! The fitness center is great and convenient!
As a college student do you know how important internet is... 212 WiFi is RUBBISH
Love living here, nice apartments and nice staff
Really great building with a great staff and nice apartments!
Great place to live. Reliable maintenance and friendly staff
Place is beautiful!!! Feel like city chicago condo
Beautiful properties and a personable staff. Love it!
i personally love this apartment !
Staff is friendly and works with you to help fix any problem!
Anthony and Michelle were very helpful.
The staff is always welcoming! 😊
Great building and great staff!
Throwing garbage ad cards in my apartment.
Love the staff and the properties!
The staff is just amazing.
Super nice staff!
read contract carefully
Nice apartments and people
Great Experience!
Terrible management

401 E Chalmers was a ok building. Lived there for 1 year. Mails and packages were not secured. Took me days to track down packages if not missing or stolen. Management didn’t do walk thru after I cleaned for a whole day. Then they only returned a portion of the first month security deposit claiming the studio needs cleaning. I had that place so clean they are ripping me off. Don’t get fool like I did. If I knew they were going to keep my deposit I wouldn’t bother cleaning!!
owner_response_text: Hi Jared, I’m sorry to hear about your experience and dissatisfaction. For security deposit disputes, we are more than happy to look into this more. We ask residents to submit these via email at jsm@jsmliving.com so we have documentation of everything. We closely review all disputes individually. Again, I'm very sorry to hear about your experience and I have passed your comments onto our management team.

review_text:
It has been a little over a year since I have been living at JSM and imo the service just keeps getting worse. I have called numerous times about various things (e.g. people coming into my apartment without warning, my parking lease, etc.) and I am (not always but commonly) met with a rude and quite condescending response.

Some of my issues have been:

- People entering my complex without a 24 hour notice (many of the instances were for bug spraying services. I was falsely told I received a packet alerting me of their schedule during my move in but I did not).
- When originally moving in, I was supposed to receive a form within 72 hours where I could report any breaks or issues with my complex. When I did not receive said form in that time frame, I called asking about it. They told me it was my fault I didn't call sooner and that I would no longer be able to report any issues.
- There were a handful of times when the garage door where my car was parked was broken and would not open. I had to find alternative options on short notice in return to get groceries, get to class, etc. When I called for it to be fixed, I waited a week before I had to call again because no one had been out to look at it. The second time I called, I asked to be emailed when it was fixed - I never received an email.

There have been a few more instances but these seemed the most relevant. If I could go back in time I would not have signed for another year. Hopefully my feedback can be a motivator for improvement.

Daughters A/C has been acting up
all summer long.
They keep telling them
Nothings wrong with and it’s 78 and getting hotter as we speak.
Their door seal is messed up on the security door and it still hasn’t been fixed.
Do better!

The staff here is so sweet and helpful, I went on few tours with Victoria and she really went out of her way to help me analyze the features to determine which properties would be worth seeing. She was so so so friendly on the tours. The prices are definitely pretty high though 😬😬

I have been renting from JSM for about 4 years now. At first I really enjoyed living in my apartment and my experience with JSM, but in the past year or so, management, maintenance, and etc have all diminished in quality. It was one thing when I could hear my next door neighbors every once in a while through my walls and my upstairs neighbors every single time they took a step. In the past weeks to year I have had to deal with putrid smelling common areas, loud neighbors playing music until 3am to the point I had to call the cops, fly and maggot infestation in the neighboring apartment that ended up affecting my unit, and my apartment door being left unlocked multiple times by JSM employees or maintenance when they came into my apartment to fix something. At this point, I am just frustrated and annoyed. I also just feel that if I called and complained that nothing would change. I have tried calling in the past and been disappointed with their response.

Jsm is absolutely amazing, yes they are a little pricey, but their price makes up in amenities, living conditions and helping staff. I had an issue that was completely my fault on my end and when I didn’t know if I could fix it I called them and they were beyond helpful. They are so kind and helpful unlike any other leasing company for students.

Try your best to never lease from jsm. They are slimier than any other leasing agency. They are rude, they don’t care about their tenants, and their maintenance is a scam. I cleaned my apartment up and down all night before moving out and went through their entire checklist they gave me for cleaning and they still charged me for 5 hours of cleaning fees. They showed a list of what they had to clean and I know for a fact it was all clean and would never take 5 hours to clean. Rotten slimy pigs…

Before renting from JSM realize that it is guaranteed that you will lose some of your deposit.  They use contract cleaning crews, and those crews are going to say they spend several hours cleaning whether it needs it or not.  I left my apartment cleaner than when I rented- it wasn’t even close.  They will charge for carpet cleaning every single time, and there is nothing that you can do about it.  JSM is not really at fault here- they HAVE to hire contractors to get through the mayhem of switchover in August.  The contractors know this and will gladly charge for what cannot be verified.  Just don’t be surprised when it happens.  Oh, and when you are cleaning out and you notice that several of your neighbors doors still have the checkout process and key envelopes taped to their doors, and that they have no intention of even trying to clean anything, just remember that whatever they take out of your deposit is helping those cleaning crews cover the extra hours they need to clean out the slacker’s apartments.  Yep- life isn’t fair.  Get used to it.

Otherwise the apartment was nice, safe and well maintained. No one paid attention to the No Smoking and No Pets rules, and no one seemed to care.

They deducted unfair, incorrect and useless charges from my deposit despite me cleaning the full house properly. For example, the bedrooms had a carpeted floor and they said don't clean it coz we'll clean it anyway and already charged like 90$ for that. Then during the inspection they add extra charge for it saying they cleaned the carpet floor and took additional money for it!
Daylight robbery! I give them 2 stars only because their maintenance was usually good. Though one winter they took their own sweet time to fix my heater, I was freezing and had to go stay at my boyfriend's house. And once the main entrance door keyhole froze and I couldn't open the door and my key got stuck to it, and they said they'll charge me extra for a key which got stuck because they didn't maintain the door properly!

I've lived with JSM for 2 years (2019-2021). I don't know if there has been a change of management or what but they seem to have improved a lot in that time. Originally, I wasn''t thrilled with them because our apartment was very dirty when we moved in in 2019 and cleaning it was a pain. However my new apartment in (fall 2020) was super clean. Maintenance is super fast, and they send people to clean the buildings pretty often which is nice. they even clean up the outside of the buildings pretty frequently. They're pretty easy to get a hold of and pretty reasonable and quick to respond when issues have come up (w neighbors, random stuff etc). Overall I would recommend

Worst place to live ever. The customer service is a joke. I call, they tell me my issue isn't their responsibility. I call who they say is responsible, that person says no actually JSM is responsible. I call JSM back, and I am greeted with instant hostility. The accounting department has the rudest person I have ever spoken to on the phone. If there is a way to rate negatively, I would. Do not live here.

I was a tenant of JSM from 2016 to 2018 while attending school at The University of Illinois. My renting experience through them was superb. However, the reason for my review goes way past that.

This is an organization that truly cares. Recently, an online holiday gift that I ordered for my fiancée was erroneously delivered to my old JSM apartment - 3 years after I had moved out.

I thought it was a lost cause when JSM called me out of the blue and told me they had received the package and would like to help return it to me! Corey, and the rest of the JSM staff worked diligently to ship the package to me 1500 miles away.

This included multiple phone calls of coordination and a trip to the post office by one of their representatives on my behalf.

I was blown away by their willingness to help and their generosity of their time.
owner_response_text: Hi William! We are very happy to hear about your experience with our Leasing Staff and Corey! Thank you for taking the time to write this review and thank you for being a JSM resident!

review_text:
I have only had good experiences living with JSM. I went to another apartment company for a year and immediately had to go back to JSM after.
They are always professional and nice. I sent a request from my Dr. to JSM for an Emotional Support Animal and the process was smooth and the staff was helpful. However, the reviews about the security deposits worry me...

Travis has been helping with a sublease and I have been really impressed with the quality of customer service. He has been very friendly, informative, and patient -- all of which are so important to people when dealing with housing. Thank you!!!

TWO MONTH UPDATE: When I was moving out of my apartment, I accidentally left an item of mine in the apartment. Not knowing what to do, I called the leasing office and spoke with Wiktoria, who was very generous with her time in the effort to track the item down. I was humbled that she would spend 10-15 minutes of her time making phone calls and trying to help. Thanks a lot. 😊
owner_response_text: Hi Tamera! Thanks so much for taking the time to leave a review on your experience with our leasing team. We are happy to hear that you had a good experience. Thanks for being a JSM resident!

review_text: I have been dealing with a noisy neighbor living above me. To be honest, the entire floor above me is just loud in general at the worst hours of the night. They are jumping around and walking like an elephant at up until 4 am. I am a college student who barely gets any sleep with 9:30 am classes. I sincerely do not need a noisy neighbor to rob me of more. Whenever I tell JSM, they just tell me to contact the police. In fact, they require a police report before they can help me deal with the situation. What the loud neighbor does is not even a crime so whenever I call the police, they can't and don't even help with the situation. This is essentially a management problem. It's almost like JSM knows that their buildings are not soundproof and expect noise complaints. Forcing residents to obtain a police report is a good excuse for them to not take any action. The only action they take is literally sending a mass email, as if that will apparently change something. When the police report is obtained, they just talk to the noisy resident and then let you know that you'll just have to deal with it. There is no better description of JSM than the term "terrible management". DO NOT live at 401, and generally just avoid them. @JSM no, I will not call you guys about my issues cause whenever I do, you guys just gaslight me and say that you'll send a mass email. Let me know when you're actually willing to fix the problem. I have made a report to the BBB cause I can't take this anymore.

Customers only gives reviews when they are annoyed so I'm here to balance haha. I lived in JSM for 2 years, and my property was sold to smile student living this Spring. Fortunately, I did not encounter too many problems during my living.
The maintenance requests were resolved very quickly, and the agents are polite and helpful. I'm glad to live with JSM but was sold =(
Anyway it's a good company to stay with !!
owner_response_text: Hey Matthew! Thank's so much for taking the time to leave us some feedback. We were sad to see those buildings and residents go too. We would love to have you back at JSM any time! Let us know when you're looking for your next apartment and we can help you out. See you soon! -Taylor G., JSM

review_text:
The good: Their locations are often top quality, the apartments are generally very well maintained, their maintenance is super responsive, and the apartments are nice in general.
The bad: Their apartments are definitely on the pricier side and generally smaller than you'd like - it's hard to host friends unless you have at least a 3 bedroom apartment. Additionally, they will get you with charges such as late fee charges for extra costs about which they do a poor job of notifying you and also some very wrong charges to your security deposit. I left my apartment cleaner than when I moved in, yet still had some wack charges to my security deposit

Leasing reputation was my #1 consideration when finding a place to live. A beautiful apartment with terrible service is unacceptable to me. That's why I chose JSM. Yes, they tend to be more expensive, yes they have a reputation of scamming you on the deposit, but man their apartments are well maintained and their service is prompt and effective, usually within 24 hrs! You get what you pay for, and in this case, a cozy, well maintained apartment experience.

JSM is a shady and scummy company that only cares about squeezing as much money as possible out of students. I lived at The Village during 2020-2021, and when I moved out into a different JSM unit they invented false cleaning charges and told me to pay them. I didn't pay them because I had pictures of the apartment showing that I had cleaned it thoroughly before moving out.

After exchanging several emails with Oscar Alvarado about this situation, I formally disputed the charges in writing and they told me that they would get back to me within one month. 45 days later, I still heard nothing back and they sent me an eviction notice telling me to pay the charges or they would evict me.

Despite being threatened with eviction, I didn't pay their phony charges. It's been two months and they still haven't corrected their error -- in fact the only thing I've gotten from them is the additional late charges they send me every month for failing to pay the outstanding balance.

Champaign-Urbana is oversaturated with crooked landlords seeking to prey on students, and JSM is no exception!
owner_response_text: Hi Charles! We are very sorry to hear about the experience you've had. This is definitely an issue we take seriously. We are working hard to get this issue resolved. You should have received a message from our team, but if you have any additional questions or concerns please call us at 217-359-6108 or email us at jsm@jsmliving.com.

review_text: Working with JSM was pretty quick and easy. The representatives were nice and willing to help always. I found my roommates through Facebook and within a week we were seriously talking about a JSM apartment. I’m excited to live there next year, but I do hold some reservations. For example, everybody always mentions the high cleaning fee they charge at the end of the year even if your apartment is clean. I am not looking forward to that, but hope all works out in the end.

The customer service is horrible. They are unhelpful, and they do nothing to make the living experience good. I moved in and fridge smelled like fish. My bedroom carpet had hairballs everywhere. JSM is charging me for a cleaning service, and I moved in to the dirtiest apartment I have ever seen. DO NOT LIVE HERE!!!!!
owner_response_text: Hi Edith, I’m sorry to hear about your experience and dissatisfaction. We can’t locate any additional cleaning requests submitted when you moved in August 2021 nor do we have record of any cleaning charges assessed as the apartment has not yet been vacated.  We’ll have a team member reach out to you to assist.

review_text: Small apartment but nice building and convenient location. I thought they were a great company to work with UNTIL it came time for them to refund your security deposit. 3 of us spent 3 hours scrubbing the apartment from top to bottom following their check out list. Nothing was left dirty!! But instead of doing a walk through with you they send your security deposit a month later and charge you for cleaning services that were done before we turned in the keys. I have managed apartment and rental properties for years and I know what I am doing. I also know the company is responsible for painting, cleaning carpets and furniture before they can rent it out again. But that is the responsibility of the apartment complex and not the tenant. I was charged for the carpet cleaning (no stains or spots) and 6 hours of cleaning time at $25 an hour for a total of $260 not refunded to me. The apartment wasn’t big enough to require 6 hours of cleaning when it was left spotless. I am so angry and it is about the principle not even the money. I could of left the apartment filthy for the same amount of money. I will contact the company directly but I will also tell everyone I know not to rent from JSM. Not only are they overpriced but they are poorly run if they do not understand what the company is responsible for vs the tenant. No one would rent an apartment that has not been professionally cleaned and painted and that is the responsibility of JSM.
owner_response_text: Hi Linda, I’m sorry to hear about your experience and dissatisfaction. The carpet cleaning fees are in your lease which we review with all tenants before they sign. We will be sure to emphasize with our staff the need to more clearly explain carpet cleaning charges at the time of the lease signing. For security deposit disputes, we are more than happy to look into this more. We ask residents to submit these via email at jsm@jsmliving.com so we have documentation of everything. We closely review all disputes individually. Again, I'm very sorry to hear about your experience and I have passed your comments onto our management team. -Paige S., JSM

review_text: JSM is a great company. The employees give great tours of the apartment complex, and they are really nice. Oscar gave us a tour of the apartments on 3rd and Clark. He was very patient even though some of our apartment mates were late. He also explained the leasing contract very clearly. JSM employees treat you well, and the company is moving in the right direction.
owner_response_text: Hi Otelo! We are very happy to hear about your experience with our Leasing Staff and Oscar! Thank you for taking the time to write this review - should you have any questions or concerns, do not hesitate to reach out to our office! -Paige P., JSM

review_text:
Summary: Make sure to move in as soon as you can in the morning and check the apartment is clean before moving your stuff in. They'll clean it and take care of maintenance before you move in then.

I've lived for JSM for 2 years already and this will be the third. Overall, the experience hasn't been bad. Most of the staff is friendly and nice. The maintenance is pretty quick and those guys do whatever they can to make sure the issue is sorted out.

That being said I moved into an apartment this year that appeared to have not been cleaned thoroughly at all before move in (spot cleaned at best). Since I moved in towards the end of the office day, I wasn't able to tell them about the issue until the next day. I choose not to move my stuff in that night, because it would have been harder to clean but also because I didn't want to move my stuff into a dirty apartment. So, to the manager at JSM who told me it was my choice not to move in, you're correct, I have standards and don't want to move into a dirty place, especially knowing I have and will be paying cleaning fees at the end of the lease.

They did clean it the next afternoon, but you should know that the cleaning money they take from you doesn't appear to be used very well. I wasted a lot of time waiting for it to get clean as well, so don't make the same mistake of expecting your apartment to be clean when you move in.

A big thank you to the lady who came and cleaned the apartment.
owner_response_text: Hi Sylvia, we do not want you feeling this way! We would like the opportunity to address/discuss any issues. Please call us at 217-359-6108 or email us jsm@jsmliving.com. Thank you! -Paige S., JSM

review_text:
I have had different experiences working with JSM. The first time we went to sign our lease they were very rude and unhelpful. They were training some new employees so that was probably the cause of the delay but regardless those helping us were needlessly rude to the questions that we had.
On our second visit we actually had a friend behind the counter and the service was much better. Although I did notice that some people were forgotten about and had to remind those behind the counter that they were, indeed, still there.
Overall, I think the services their apartments offer are very nice but the customer service could use some work.

I lived at the 505 E Healey residence (5 person apartment) during the 2019-2020 year and have resigned for the 2020-2021 year. Pricing is fair for the quality, and all pricing components are explained clearly. The leasing process is straightforward and the employees (leasing agents particularly) are kind, patient, and overall very helpful. The quality of our apartment had some issues upon moving in (cleanliness), however once the issues were brought to JSM’s attention, full cleaning, painting, and furniture crews were sent promptly to right the wrongs. JSM isn’t perfect, but they are honest and fair, and I feel that they genuinely care about their tenants’ satisfaction and whenever applicable, will take steps to improve the experience they provide.

I lived with JSM for a year and they are by far one of the better if not the best apartment agency in CU. We got a sweet deal at one of the apartment. Maintenance request are always quickly solved. Our agent Oscar Alvarado was always very responsive and helpful whenever I have questions/concerns. Very sad that I had to move out!
owner_response_text: Hi Dianne! First and foremost, thank you for choosing JSM and for this kind review! We are thrilled that you enjoyed living with us. I will be passing your comments along to our maintenance and management team! Thanks again for choosing JSM! -Paige S., JSM

review_text: Took out about $200 (not including the carpet cleaning) of my security deposit for the cleaning fee when I left my apartment clean. Maybe I left a bit of dust here and there, but that certainly won't take 6 hours to clean unless the maintenance workers were chugging beer and playing board games while doing it. Apartment that I lived in was nice. But as a leasing agency which I am reviewing this for, JSM is just terrible.
owner_response_text: Hi Karl, I’m so sorry to hear about your dissatisfaction. We are always more than happy to look into security deposit disputes. We ask residents to submit their disputes to jsm@jsmliving.com so that we have documentation of everything. We always review each dispute individually. Again, I am so sorry to hear about your experience. -Kenzie S., JSM

review_text:
Just moved in a few days ago and I love how easy and accommodating JSM was with the whole process! They answered all of my questions and were very patient with me, a first time renter. The room was clean (emphasis on WAS... I moved in and now it's a total mess) and I got notification emails on good move in dates.
Overall, JSM is great with communication, they respond quickly and with exactly what I need. They made the whole process of renting easy and stress free!
owner_response_text: Hi Preston, Thanks for sharing! We're glad to hear your experience has been great! Thanks for choosing JSM and we're glad to have you as one of our residents! -Scott C.

review_text:
Where do I start...
This place is the pinnacle of apartments, DONT LIVE HERE. Your paying $700 a month for a literal jail cell. The hallways are narrow and only allow one person to pass at a time, or you need to be skin to skin contact to pass another. The room itself is terrible. My apartment room had terrible insulation and was hitting below freezing temps in the wintertime, and you cant even control the heating because there is none. There's mold in the bathroom and it's so unsanitary. The shower head is broken and is stiff, so you cant move it or you risk it breaking. The toilet is BROWN and nasty, no matter what cleaning equipment you use to clean it. The room itself is super small and you basically have nowhere to put your stuff. The kitchen isn't even a kitchen, you can legit only make ramen or go out to eat. The laundry room is terrible and doesn't wash your clothes properly, so I hand washed all of mine. And don't get me started on that Karen of a manager. They did absolutely nothing to resolve any of my issues, and they will do ANYTHING to scam you of your security deposit, knowing that we're students without money. Just shell out another 100-200 bucks on another apartment that is nicer than this hell hole.

I have been living with JSM in 700 S. Gregory St. for a little over 2 months now. I love it so much that I decided to resign with JSM for another year! The apartment complex is clean, quiet, and functional. The JSM employees are all very friendly, and make the process of finding and leasing an apartment smooth and worry-free as possible. I would recommend JSM as a lessor to just about anyone on the University of Illinois campus.
owner_response_text: Thanks for the kind words Gary! We're glad to hear you're calling Gregory Place home for 2017 as well! Enjoy! -Scott C., JSM

review_text: Several of my interactions with office staff resulted in the worst customer service I've ever endured. Incredibly inconvenient renovations were conducted while I was living in the apartment, including flooring replacement and painting. Claimed it took 5.4 hours to clean my apartment after I moved out even though my roommate and I both went through the entire cleaning checklist provided to us before moving out, and 90% of the cleaning they cited on our deposit return was labeled as "needs wiped down". I can't imagine it taking 5.4 hours to wipe down surfaces which were probably just dusty which occurs whether someone cleans it or not. Honestly, so happy I no longer live there.
owner_response_text: Hi Peggy, I'm so sorry to hear about your dissatisfaction and experience! At JSM, we try our best to minimize the impact our renovation and improvement process can have. Regarding security deposit disputes, please email your dispute to jsm@jsmliving.com, one of our office managers will be more than happy to review it. Please be as detailed as possible! Again, I'm sorry to hear about your experience. Call us at 217-359-6108 should you have any questions. Thank you! -Paige S., JSM

review_text: This company will steal your security deposit. I was charged for missing furniture that was never provided to my apartment. In addition, after three of us cleaned a studio apartment, I was charged for over 6 hours of cleaning. Luckily I had a few videos and photos and attempted to dispute the claim, however they have yet to reply despite saying that I would receive a response within a month of my dispute. Unprofessional company that steals from tenants and then lies about trying to resolve it. Please do not rent from them if you value your deposit but also value an honest company.

My roommates and I ran into a snag during move-in in which the kitchen sink in our unit was backing up; however, we called the JSM emergency hotline and we had our unit fixed within a few hours. Every time we've needed maintenance, JSM would help us out ASAP. The JSM policies and procedures are also very clear and easy to understand. JSM reps at the office are very friendly and helpful.
owner_response_text: Hey Marcellus! Thanks so much for your feedback. We're so glad you've enjoyed your experience and that our maintenance team was able to fix your sink so quickly. We pride ourselves on having a full time maintenance staff to be able to handle issues like this quickly and effectively. Thank you for being a JSM resident!

review_text: Since I first decided to look into JSM properties for my Fall 2014 apartment, I have had a great experience. The office staff was friendly every single time I called. My leasing agent was knowledgeable about all of their building and answered all of the questions that he could. For the questions he couldn't answer off the top of his head, he told me he would email me and did so within an hour of our appointment and addressed all of my concerns. At my signing appointment was greeted by the friendly office staff that I had spoken with on the phone and they did a wonderful job of explaining the lease information and getting me in and out in a timely manner. I am looking forward to my new apartment in the Fall and being a JSM resident!

JSM is extremely unresponsive when it comes to utility services. I recently moved in to 401 E Chalmers. For about a week, I have been trying to get a pay card for the laundry machines. The pay card dispensing machine doesn't work properly. I have contacted JSM several times and  their response has been that they will get it sorted soon. Very disappointed. I don't have the time to repeatedly make calls to get a $5.00 laundry card ! Also I had a short summer sublease and at the end I was unfairly charged $135 for 4.5 hrs of cleaning. According to JSM the floor required cleaning and nothing else. Why does it take 4.5 hrs to clean the floor of a less than 300 sq ft studio apartment ? RIDICULOUS !

DON'T EVER rent your apartment with JSM!!! They simply can enter your apartment WHENEVER they want. I have lived with them for two years. Now I cannot wait to escape from their property and move into my new apartment. This year around, they stormed into my apartment like no one is living here at least 5 times for all kinds of excuse (not taking account for countless JSM staffs knocking on my door for showing without ANY advance notice). There's one time that I had enough of them and must live in hotel for a week!! Basically they keep renovating the apartment even there are still tenants living there. I have read all the previous reviews and found out that as a tenant you can say nothing about it. Because they mention somewhere in your contract that they simply have the right to do that!! How stupid I am not realizing their unfair clause until this moment.

给广大中国学生学者提个醒。JSM这家房东喜欢利用租约里的不合理条款，随意进出租户的公寓，特别是进行公寓的翻新，严重影响租户的正常生活。且他们喜欢在租约到期前一两个月进行翻新，就是看着大家不再租他们家房子的时候，为所欲为。我们这个楼自去年冬天开始到现在，大大小小的翻新进行了不下5次，大到上房揭瓦（完全没有夸张）小到更换茶几，最近一两个月（5，6 月）来的尤其频繁。房子里的东西几乎都被换了个遍，最夸张的一次是换暖气，我们不得不在酒店里边住了一周。大家可以想象一下，你明明每个月花1200刀租了房子，到头来要去住宾馆是怎样的一种体验！如果你不想和我们一样，请小心JSM。P.S.我们不是喜欢到处写评论的人，这次实在是忍不了，所以说一说我们的血泪史!!!!!
owner_response_text: Hi Xiu, thank you for writing this review. I am very sorry to hear about your dissatisfaction. We do our best to accommodate upgrades and renovations around our tenants schedules. We always give at least 24 hours notice when work will be taking place in your unit or building. Our showing policy allows our leasing agent to show units only during designated show hours and will no longer show your apartment once it is leased. Please let me know if you have any questions or further concerns.  -Paige P., JSM

review_text: Do not live in JSM's apartments. They show your apartment to others every day without noticing you in advance if you do not renew the lease for next year, which is really annoying. And when you reach out to them about this issue, they ask you to try to understand them and be cooperate.

The exterior of the place looks nice. They do no take care of their tenants though. I stayed in an apartment building on the first floor and the upstairs laundry hose burst causing the place to flood. They sent someone to do a poor job wet vacuuming hours later and the place was still damp. They offered zero accommodation and due to the dampness mushrooms started to grow from inside the walls and they started to perturbed out. I called and requested an emergency maintainer request because this can be potentially dangerous as I didn’t know what kind of mushrooms they were and how far the problem went without tearing out the lining of the wall. After getting off the phone I was told that someone was coming the day of. When I called back 4 hours later it was said that this maintainence was marked as non-emergency and will be queued as first come first serve. They didn’t even bother to have someone look at it to even assess the situation to see if it was dangerous. Moral of the story is that JSM is a company that severely lacks in care for its tenants. 100% stay away

I was renting through Green Street last year and their customer service leaves much to be desired. JSM has been a very nice contrast; their support staff is very friendly and they have gone out of their way to find information for me (for example, a floor plan that had to be requested from the building architect because I wanted to make sure my things would fit in my new apartment).

I have had nothing but good experiences with JSM and I highly recommend them if you are looking for an apartment.

When first signing for a lease with JSM two years ago, my friends and I had many questions. The staff at JSM promptly answered every question and were friendly and so willing to help. Once we figured out what apartments we wanted to see a JSM leasing agent drove us to the different locations and was again able to answer all of the questions we had about the apartments. The leasing process was quick, easy and free! My past two years living with JSM have been wonderful: friendly and professional office staff, prompt and efficient maintenance crews and so much more! I would recommend JSM to anyone looking for apartments in the Champaign-Urbana area.

Jsm is absolutely amazing. Their maintenance crew is always on top of their game and they always fix things within 24 hours. Their buildings are old, but they are still in good shape. My only complaint is that they didn't tell me that my building was going to be under construction when I signed my lease. It makes it impossible to sleep-in or study. But even with that, JSM has made my experience nice enough that I renewed my lease to stay with them again next year.

I've had a great experience viewing apartments and signing with JSM. The leasing agent was on-time, very personable, and promptly answered all of our questions. My roommate and I were able to make an appointment and sign our lease within the week. If you haven't signed a lease yet, I would highly suggest looking to JSM for available properties.

I have lived with JSM for two years now. and I regret it not being for longer. I have had nothing but positive experiences with this company. The maintenance staff is personable and very efficient. The office staff is extremely helpful, and the apartment was cleaned upon move in, which is something some of the other property management companies on campus struggle with. I cannot sing my praises enough for this wonderful property management company.

JSM has easy renting and payment procedures and good value in their apartments. Repairs and services are usually very punctual and thorough. The VIP membership and the gym are indispensable as well - I use the gym almost daily.
What a ridiculous company! Left the apartment so spotless and are charging over $150 from security deposit! Some furnishings were RUSTY!!! These guys are the  #1 experts in fleecing college students!
owner_response_text: Hi Jaswant, I’m sorry to hear about your experience and dissatisfaction. The carpet cleaning fees are in your lease which we review with all tenants before they sign. We will be sure to emphasize with our staff the need to more clearly explain carpet cleaning charges at the time of the lease signing. For security deposit disputes, we are more than happy to look into this more. We ask residents to submit these via email at jsm@jsmliving.com so we have documentation of everything. We closely review all disputes individually. Again, I'm very sorry to hear about your experience and I have passed your comments onto our management team.

review_text: My experience with JSM has been awesome. Currently, I am living in one of their apartments in Urbana (701 S. Gregory St.) in a 1 bedroom. The location is perfect for my needs as a college student. The price is accurate for the location, amenities, and services. I have submitted 2 small maintenance requests and they have responded within hours of the same day. Also, they do monthly pest control, as well as checking windows during University breaks (winter break, spring break,etc.) to make sure windows are locked so deter theft. I am looking forward to living with JSM next year as well.
owner_response_text: Hi Mary! We are thrilled to hear about your experience with JSM! I have passed your kind comments onto our team. Thank you so much for taking the time to write this review and thank you for choosing JSM - we are glad to have you! -Paige P., JSM

review_text: JSM is super friendly and they have great options for apartment living. My switch over to them is definitely a positive change for my next year living arrangements. Super amazing apartments! Already basically half-live with my friend who rents from them and I'm impressed.
owner_response_text: Hi Cheri, Thanks for the kind words! We're glad to hear you enjoy our apartments and we can't wait to have you as a resident! -Scott C., JSM

review_text: The apartment was fine, but like others, JSM tried to steal my deposit. $180 (6 hours @ $30/hr) to clean a 600 square foot apartment? Fortunately, I had a video taken on the day I moved out proving that the place was spotless. I took the video to student legal services and wrote a harsh email to JSM asking for a full refund. I got the refund only because of that video.
owner_response_text: Hi Rayford. I am so sorry to hear of your experience. JSM is always happy to look into any security deposit questions and I am happy that your dispute was resolved. -Kenzie S., JSM

review_text: JSM offers reasonably priced apartments and management for the UIUC campus. You might not love their offerings if you are looking for incredibly high-end apartments, but for maximizing good location, low price, and cooperative management, I think JSM works well (at least for undergrad students). I have leased with University Group before, and their offerings are comparable (U. Group tends to be a bit cheaper, but that comes with difference in management, as well as some rickety buildings). My experience with U. Group was fine, no major problems other than a fire in my building that made it so no one could stay in the building, which some people at U. Group worked with me extremely hard to ensure things were fixed by the school year (though it was still inconvenient). The JSM apartments I have looked at appear to have better kitchens with more space and counter tops to avoid things being cluttered around the stove, where fires have a tendency to break out. Though I haven't started my lease with them, I have heard good things and had good experiences with the apartment showings and leasing appointment I had. I will be back to review with more material regarding any particularly good/bad experiences I have during the lease.

My student just moved out of GST. They cleaned the apartment before vacating, I'm sure it wasn't perfect. However, in no event could it EVER take 13 hours of additional cleaning time. This is what the kids were billed for. This is our second student living there, the same thing happened prior. JSM will bill you for outrageous cleaning and other misc BS fees then deduct from your security deposit well after you've moved out. Sad that they are taking advantage of students and families especially during this time.  Just know what you are getting with this low class provider.

I was able to schedule an apartment viewing and leasing appointment really easily over the phone, and really quickly. The staff that showed me the apartment was friendly, nice, and went beyond what’s on paper and shared her personal experience living in a similar apartment. The leasing office staff was also very friendly.
owner_response_text: Hi Luis - We are thrilled to hear about your experience with us! Thank you so much for the kind review! If you need anything at all don't hesitate to get in contact with us. Thanks again! -Paige S., JSM

review_text: I have had nothing but a negative experience with JSM. I had originally signed with a different realtor and LOVED them. Super nice and helpful. However, in January they sold my building to JSM and everything just went downhill from there. First, they did not inform us they were taking over our building or how to make payments to them. It wasn't until my roommate had to make a trip down to the apartment to pick stuff up before school started again that we saw a letter on the front door notifying us of the change. After that, they started doing renovations without even telling us. It wasn't until I was woken up at 8am to loud noises coming from outside that I had realized that is what they were doing. There have also been many occasions where we get an email saying they will be turning off the water for some random period of time THE DAY OF. This caused an inconvenience on more than just one occasion. My apartment complex and any cars parked in the lot for the past several months have been dirty because of all the renovations that are taking place. My roommates had to move their cars on several occasions as well with nowhere to park so they can do their renovations.  JSM's management team is also horrible. They are extremely rude and only care about getting their payments. The do not care at all about their tenants. You can put your rent online or by check in person with JSM. I tried paying my check online one month and thought that it had gone through only to find out, several months later when I was about to leave for summer and had subleased my room, that my check never went through. There was NO help from anyone at JSM and I had to figure out what was wrong. After searching for a few days I found out that their online system was down when I was trying to pay and it never went through. We were never informed that their system was down and had to find out from an email that we were $400 short on rent months later. What I have learned this year is JSM does not care about their tenants even in the slightest. They want money and they'll do whatever they can to get it. I will make sure that after I post this review, my roommates and I will tell everyone we know to never rent with them because they will be guarenteed a miserable experience.
owner_response_text: Hi Marissa, First and foremost we apologize for the noise and inconvenience during our renovation/building upgrade process and we will continue to do our utmost to minimize the renovation’s impact on your quality of life as a JSM resident. I also apologize for any technical difficulties with our website. Please continue to inform us of any questions or concerns you may have by calling our office at 217-359-6108. Again, we apologize for the inconvenience and we hope you enjoy the new building upgrades once completed. Thank you very much for sharing and we appreciate the feedback. This helps us improve our training and overall systems.–Scott C.

review_text: Me and my roommates recently signed a lease for a JSM apartment, and overall our experience has been alright. The lady who showed us our apartment was very helpful and informative. She was also very quick in giving us the next steps in the signing process and sending out a follow up email. The only thing that wasn't very pleasant was how some of the JSM office workers were not very polite when speaking to some of my roommates. In addition, when we came in to sign our lease and were waiting, no one at the front desk even tried to pay attention to us waiting there. Basically, we were seen but ignored for about 20 minutes. Other groups of people came in and they were helped but we weren't. That's all!!
owner_response_text:
Hi Elizabeth,

I’m sorry to hear about your experience with our front office staff. I will forward your feedback to our office manager so we can better improve our service. Thank you for your honest feedback and for choosing JSM! –Scott C.

review_text: The people in the leasing office were very friendly. The process took around an hour to review the lease and sign, and then we were on our way. Overall, the process was not too difficult ans I am excited to live in a JSM apartment next year.

My roommates and I had to relocate due to a serious safety issue at our current place. I talked to Jasmine from JSM and she was nothing but accommodating. She showed us an apartment available and was very patient and flexible. She understood our situation and was very quick on giving us answers due to our horrible situation. Even though there were questions she was uncertain, she went above and beyond to give us answers and try and help us out. Highly recommend her to anyone who is considering renting with JSM in the future.
owner_response_text: Hi Diana! Thanks for the kind words! I will pass your comments along to Jasmine! Thanks again! -Scott C.,  JSM

review_text:
So a couple things--

1) JSM is a MEDICORE leasing company at best. They lied to my apartment multiple times saying that they cleaned it and cleaned our carpets before our move-in. This was absolutely not the case and we went back and forth for a whole week until they finally sent someone to inspect our apartment because they didn't "believe us."

2) One leasing agent in particular walked in on my friend who leases an efficiency with them to show the apartment. Yes, it is written in the lease that they are given full consent to show the apartment without giving a notice beforehand. But, they are required to 1. Knock the door 3 times 2. Go inside FIRST BEFORE they take their potential clients in to make sure no one is in there or no one is being disturbed. She (Andirana Davis) did not do a walk through to check and see if my friend was in the efficiency or not. She was sleeping when 3 random strangers walked in without warning and WATCHED HER SLEEP. JSM claimed that their employees are trained to check the apartment BEFORE letting people in.
